articleTitle: Task Caching and Computation Offloading for Muti-User Mobile Edge Computing Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Mobile edge computing (MEC) can sink the computation capability near the device terminal, reduce the task data backhaul delay and greatly relieve the pressure of the core network compared with cloud computing. With the exponential growth of delay sensitive application services, edge caching gradually rises as a promising technique by pre-storing data at edge server for user devices to be free from task data transmission and reduce edge computing cost. In this paper, an edge computing network model with caching mechanism is established to maximize system utility defined by weighted sum of energy consumption and execution delay. An alternating iteration algorithm based on modified binary particle swarm optimization algorithm (MBPSO) and convex optimization is proposed to solve the joint task caching and offloading optimization problem. Simulation results show that compared with other benchmark schemes, our proposed algorithm can effectively improve system performance.

articleTitle: Research of target detection and distance measurement technology based on YOLOv5 and depth camera
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Target detection and distance measurement technology based on YOLOv5 and depth camera is proposed for positioning the shelter in the field shelter hospitals deployment process by the shelter-transporting automated guided vehicle (AGV). This paper studies the principle of YOLOv5 target detection and the depth camera imaging and ranging model. The square capsule data set and the engineering implementation code of target detection and ranging technology are formed. The scenario test of AGV's positioning to the square capsule is completed. The test results show that the target detection and distance measurement technology proposed in this paper can be better applied to the actual engineering of AGVs for the positioning of the shelter, and the average accuracy of target detection is more than 95%. The distance measurement error is less than 0.1 m. The combination of target detection technology and depth camera can be effectively applied to the engineering practice, improving the field shelter hospitals' rapid deployment capability and intelligence.

articleTitle: A QoS Multicast Routing Protocol for Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Multicast routing algorithm is an important part of the network layer in ad hoc networks. Its main goal is to find an optimal multicast tree that can meet QoS constraints. So the network can not only meet the QoS requirements of data services, but also improve the efficiency of limited network resources. In this paper, we propose a QoS multicast routing protocol, QMRP, which uses an optimization algorithm with multiple QoS objectives to compute the optimal QoS characteristics for the data currently to be delivered. After the source node in the mobile network sends a routing request message, the neighboring nodes selectively forward the message according to their QoS composite index, and the destination node will process the message according to the specific situation after receiving it. Simulation experiments prove that it can significantly improve the transmission rate of mobile network nodes, enhance the stability of the network, and provide strong support for QoS services in Ad Hoc networks.

articleTitle: Identification Algorithm of Diseased Leaves based on MobileNet Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a model algorithm based on transfer learning combined with MobileNet to realize fast and accurate identification of potato leaf diseases on the Pytorch framework platform. Firstly, data enhancement, image scaling, image denoising and image normalization were carried out on the primary data set. After feature simplification, a pre-trained MobileNet model was used as the backbone network, and the improved MobileNet model was constructed by channel devolution and attention mechanism to identify the disease leaf. Enhance the recognition accuracy, robustness and generalization ability of the model. The results show that the recognition and classification accuracy of the improved MobileNet algorithm is improved to 99.67%, and the recognition efficiency and robustness are improved.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Energy Efficient Power Allocation for NOMA System in High-Speed Railway Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the application of non-orthogonal mutiple access (NOMA) technology in wireless communication systems in high-speed rail scenarios to solve the uplink energy efficiency of NOMA systems. User's quality of service (QoS) and maximum transmit power constraints are considered, the objective function is constructed as an optimization model to maximize energy efficiency. Based on fractional programming, the energy efficiency maximization problem is converted to a series of subtractive subproblems. The problem is solved by Lagrange dual method, and the Lagrange dual variables are updated using the sub gradient method, a low-complexity optimal power allocation scheme based on the Dinkelbach method is proposed. The simulation results show that under the constraints of the same maximum transmit power and QoS requirements, the NOMA system can always obtain better energy efficiency performance than the traditional orthogonal multiple access (OMA).

articleTitle: Federated Learning-based Privacy-Preserving Traffic Flow Prediction Scheme for VANETs
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) bring us a lot of convenience. However, the credibility of the messages transmitted among vehicles and the security of VANETs still face risks and challenges. In this paper, we propose a privacy-preserving traffic flow prediction scheme based on federated learning and long short-term memory recurrent neural network (LSTM RNN), which can perform traffic flow prediction for VANETs. We use LSTM RNN as the deep learning neural network for predicting traffic flow. Federated learning framework is used for model interaction and data privacy protection. Security and performance analysis show that the proposed scheme can not only predict the traffic flow, but also protect the privacy of users and model.

articleTitle: Interoperability Research and Experiments in 4G/5G Netwok
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To ensure that UEs enjoy uninterrupted service during 4G/5G mobility, the network needs to provide effective mobility management. In 4G/5G networks, mobility management can be divided into cell reselection, handover and redirection, depending on whether the UE is in an idle or connected state. The article focuses on mobility management in 5G systems and interoperability schemes between 4G/5G, as well as mobility management experiments in existing networks, to provide a reference for optimising mobility management functions in 4G/5G networks.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Clutter Suppression Technique based on Environmental Perception
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In engineering practice, fixed MTI clutter suppression strategy is often applied, which cannot match the change of environment quickly. It leads to the increase of radar false alarm rate, and seriously affects the normal detection radar targets and directly affects the tactical effect of air defense combat command system. In this paper, signal processor processes the data before and after MTI cancellation separately in purpose, then get the cancellation ratio in the range of full distance in minimum scale and set the cancellation parameters in specific distance section after much iteration. So as to realize the dynamic selection of MTI cancellation algorithm, to improve the adaptive and fast matching of clutter suppression strategy to changing environment, and to achieve the dynamic balance between target detection probability and false alarm rate. This method can improve the radar's clutter environment sensing ability and adaptive clutter processing ability, and it helps radar have good target detection performance in the clutter or interference environment.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Entropy and KNN in Motor Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Traditional motor bearing fault diagnosis methods lack effective feature extraction and high fault diagnosis accuracy. In this paper, a method for combining wavelet energy entropy and cubic KNN algorithm to motor fault diagnosis was proposed based on the Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center's experimental data. The diagnostic results of the cubic KNN algorithm without introducing the vibration signal feature value of motor bearing were compared with that of the cubic KNN algorithm after introducing time-domain features, frequency domain features, and wavelet entropy feature to verify the diagnostic effect of the proposed method. The results showed that the KNN diagnosis error rate of motor bearing equipment fault diagnosis is effectively reduced from 0.22 to 0, the diagnostic accuracy was significantly improved by 94.34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>and the method has high application value in the fault diagnosis of motor bearings.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Reinforcement Learning in Financial Quantitative Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Quantitative trading refers to the use of computer technology and mathematical algorithms to carry out financial transactions. Investors formulate trading strategies based on historical data to avoid irrational investment decisions made by investors due to subjective emotional fluctuations as much as possible, and ultimately maximize profits. In recent years, artificial intelligence technology has been developing rapidly. Inspired by Alpha Go decision game theory, this paper introduces deep reinforcement learning algorithm into the field of financial quantitative trading. Deep reinforcement learning algorithm can effectively solve the learning problem with long-term goals and delayed reward, and has high applicability for financial stock market. The proposed deep reinforcement learning algorithm adopts the Deep Q Network (DQN), and the reward function is carefully designed for different output actions, so that the model can better capture the hidden dependencies and potential dynamics in stock data. The double-average trading strategy is adopted to improve the accuracy of decision-making, and ultimately maximize profits by learning the trading rules. In order to evaluate the superiority of the model, this paper compares it with other deep reinforcement learning algorithms. Finally it verifies the advantages of DQN algorithm in the decision-making environment of stock trading and the feasibility of applying deep reinforcement learning model to financial quantitative trading.

articleTitle: A High-throughput Hardware Implementation of ZUC-256 Stream Cipher
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The ZUC-256 stream cipher algorithm has been incorporated into the security portfolio of 3GPP LTE-Advanced. Therefore, it is important to study its high-performance implementation. In this paper, we present a high-throughput hardware implementation of the ZUC-256 cryptographic algorithm for ASICs and FPGAs. By using a fully pipelined design scheme, the critical path of the algorithm in both operating modes is significantly shortened and the operating frequency is increased. The throughput of ZUC-256 is up to 160Gpbs with the area 15500GEs under TSMC 12nm technology. In comparison with other work, the area efficiency of the ASIC implementation is improved by 1.61 times and that of FPGA is improved by 1.06 times while the throughput rate is significantly improved.

articleTitle: The spatial cross-correlation of received voltage envelopes under non-line-of-sight
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Physical-layer key (PLK) generation scheme is a new key generation scheme based on wireless channel reciprocity. However, the security of physical layer keys still lacks sufficient theoretical support in the presence of eavesdropping attacks until now, which affects the promotion in practical applications. By analyzing the propagation mode of multipath signals under non-line-of-sight (nLoS), an improved spatial cross-correlation model is constructed, where the spatial cross-correlation is between eavesdropping channel and legitimate channel. Results show that compared with the multipath and obstacle distribution of the channel, the azimuth and distance between the eavesdropper and the eavesdropped user have a greater impact on the cross-correlation.

articleTitle: Research on Gas Turbine Early Warning Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: By analyzing historical data of gas turbine units, A parameter trend analysis method for building a baseline model using a neural network (CNN-LSTM) combined with a convolutional neural network and a long short-term memory network is proposed.Compare the built benchmark model with the actual values of the operating parameters of the unit, and use the generated deviation as the monitoring object. The operating parameters of the gas turbine are prompted to change, and an early warning is issued when the corresponding monitoring object exceeds the threshold.This method is a simple and effective system abnormality analysis method in gas turbine fault early warning, and t can provide guidance for subsequent fault classification.

articleTitle: A Blind Estimation Method of QPSK/OQPSK Symbol Rate
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In digital communications, the accurate estimation of symbol rate is extremely important for both blind demodulation of non-cooperative communications and radio spectrum monitoring. An instantaneous frequency symbol rate estimation method is proposed in this paper for the QPSK signals. The method determines the symbol rate of the signal by detecting the position of the spectral peak of the instantaneous frequency power spectrum. The instantaneous frequency power spectrum of the OQPSK signal does not have a distinct symbol rate spectrum due to the offset between the in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) components of the signal. To address this issue, this paper also proposes a symbol rate estimation method based on the signal envelope spectrum. This method performs spectrum analysis on the envelope of the analytical signal and has high estimation accuracy for the symbol rate of the OQPSK signal. The simulation analysis and practical signal verify the feasibility and validity of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Folk melody generation based on CNN-BiGRU and Self-Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Using various deep learning networks to generate music is a research hotspot in the field of human intelligence. Due to the limitation of network structure in the existing melody generation models, the quality of melody generation is poor. In this paper, for folk melody, we propose a melody generation network based on CNN-BiGRU and Self-Attention. First, the processed data is input into the CNN module consisting of one-dimensional convolution layer and pooling layer to extract local features. Then, the features extracted by CNN module are constructed as time series and is input into BiGRU network to extract global features. Finally, Self-Attention assigns different weights to the features of BiGRU output to highlight important feature information during note generation. Experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of the proposed model is improved by 3.61 % compared with BiGUR, 5.26% compared with CNN, and 6.53% compared with CNN-BiGRU. Meanwhile, the model presented in this paper also achieves improvement in other evaluation measures.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion detection approach based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Facing the complex and changeable network environment, network intrusion detection system (NIDS) is still an important means of defense. In this paper, we propose a deep learning model to identify potential multiple attacks and intrusions in the network. The model is divided into PAOS (Pareto Over Sample) class imbalance processing module and DRCNN (Deep Residual Convolutional Neural Network) intrusion detection module. The former is used to reduce the noise introduced by oversampled data, and the latter is based on the residual structure of one-dimensional convolutional neural network for learning and identifying various attacks in the network. Experiments are performed on the CICIDS2017 dataset. The 15-classs classification accuracy of the classifier can reach 99.86%. The results show that the PAOS-DRCNN model can effectively identify a variety of different attacks, such as DOS, port scan, DDoS, Bot and so on.

articleTitle: A Convolution Neural Network-based Method for Sea Ice Remote Sensing using GNSS-R Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Sea ice remote sensing is of great significance to the understanding of polar climate change. At present, the global navigation satellite system reflector (GNSS-R) technology has been applied to the study of sea ice remote sensing and achieved good results. In this paper, a convolution neural network (CNN) based method for sea ice recognition (SIR) and estimation of sea ice concentration (SIC) using GNSS-R data is proposed. Specifically, a CNN model is designed to solve the classification problem of SIR and the regression problem of SIC estimation. In the stage of data set construction, first, the global GNSS-R data (TDS-l), in a certain period of time, is spatiotemporally matched with the relatively reliable sea ice data (NSIDC), and then the matched GNSS-R data is extracted to balance the amount of seawater data and sea ice data. In the stage of CNN model construction, the feature learning ability of the model is enhanced by adding convolution layer, pooling layer and full connection layer. Simulation results show that the proposed CNN -based scheme has a higher prediction accuracy of SIR and lower estimation error of SIC than other existing methods.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Regularization Study for Accurate 3D LiDAR Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: LiDAR object detection is a fundamental task for understanding the 3D world. State-of-the-art 3D detectors tend to apply novel regularization approaches to achieve better ranks in challenging leaderboards. However, there is a key question that how these auxiliary regularizations affect the detector without bells and whistles. In this paper, we apply several popular auxiliary losses and guide approaches to a highly popular and widely used 3D detection baseline model to explore how these mechanisms affect 3D object detection. Extensive experiments on KITTI from different perspectives demonstrate that these auxiliary regularizations can bring benefits to the 3D LiDAR object detection.

articleTitle: Recognition of Human Sleep Pressure Posture Image Using Deep Residual Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Good sleep is essential for people. Sleep posture has been widely studied as a means of evaluating sleep quality. This paper proposes a sleep posture recognition method based on a deep residual network. The computational complexity is reduced by introducing residual blocks and omitting the complex manual feature extraction process. An unconstrained intelligent mattress system based on a flexible pressure sensor array is developed, which provides a comfortable and high-resolution solution for long-term sleep monitoring. Five testers conducted test experiments on the smart mattress to simulate the real sleep scene. The experimental results show that our method can accurately identify the seven categories (sitting, right trunk type, right fetal type, supine, left trunk type, left fetal type, and prone), and the overall recognition rate is 98%. The results showed that the system performed well in sleep research, which provided a basis for subsequent pressure ulcer prevention and drop warning. Our research provides a set of solutions and ideas for the follow-up study of intelligent mattress systems.

articleTitle: ATO Operation Optimization Research Based on Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the safety, efficiency and energy saving of the train ATO operation process, this paper first establishes a multi-objective model from two aspects: the optimization of the train operation strategy and the recommended train speed profile. Secondly, the feasibility of choosing the ABC algorithm as the solution algorithm is demonstrated by comparing the optimization performance of the artificial bee colony algorithm and the particle swarm algorithm, as well as the differential evolution algorithm. Then the ABC algorithm is proposed to solve the maneuvering condition sequence to find the maneuvering condition transition point with the lowest energy consumption under the premise of meeting the operation requirements. Finally, the train operation process is simulated by MATLAB to verify the effectiveness of applying the ABC algorithm to the study of automatic train driving strategy.

articleTitle: A Column Searching-based Multiple-point Statistics for Efficient Image Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of digital image generation technology, geological image modeling and analysis have shown great potential in groundwater management and oil exploration. Reconstructed images are used to investigate the spatial structure and petrophysical properties. As a powerful method of geological modeling, Multiple-point Statistics (MPS) algorithms are able to create high-quality 2D or 3D models on the basis of Training Image (TI). Within MPS framework the dataset is a key component to store the spatial structures. However, a key limitation is computational efficiency, mostly attributed to the slow speed of finding desired patterns in datasets. To improve the efficiency of image generation, we propose a multiple-point statistics method called Column Searching Simulation (CSSIM). The core idea is to apply column searching to quickly search similar patterns in the dataset. In addition, an early-stopping strategy is designed to facilitate geometrical structure reproduction. We apply the proposed method to 2D channelized reservoir image generation. The variogram and Analysis of Distance are applied to assess image generation quality. Compared with the existing method, our CSSIM significantly improves the image generation efficiency while yielding comparable quality.

articleTitle: Bowtie Antenna Based on Artificial Magnetic Conductor Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A wideband high gain bowtie antenna loaded with Artificial Magnetic Conductor (AMC) structure is proposed. Firstly, a wideband bowtie antenna is designed, and the wideband characteristics are achieved by loading the upper feeding branch with two open stubs perpendicular to it to form multiple resonances. Then, according to the characteristics of the in-phase reflection of the AMC structure, the wideband AMC array matching the operating frequency of the bowtie antenna is designed as its grounding plate. The proposed AMC structure is composed of 6x9 units, which is placed under the bowtie antenna to achieve high gain and broadband characteristics, and also reduce the profile. The simulation results show that the back lobe of the radiation pattern of the bowtie antenna is significantly suppressed with AMC, meanwhile, the gain is improved from 1.68 to 8.75dBi, within 2.39~3.52GHz.

articleTitle: CTSRMV: A Chinese Text Image Super-Resolution Method Based on Mobile ViT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A large number of text images come from natural scenes. However, most of them are taken by non professional cameras such as mobile phones, and their resolution is low, which greatly reduces the readability of the text in the images. The text image super-resolution method aims to enhance the low resolution image to obtain a clearer text image. At present, with the appearance of convolutional neural network, image super-resolution technology has developed rapidly. The traditional super-resolution method is mainly used for natural scene images, and is usually not suitable for text. Many scholars have proposed super-resolution network methods for text images, but most of them are based on English text. Due to the complexity and diversity of Chinese texts, these networks are not suitable for Chinese texts. In order to improve the shortcomings of the above methods, a Chinese text dataset is generated, and a text-image super-resolution lightweight network based on Mobile ViT is also proposed. Experiments show that our proposed dataset CTW is meaningful for the study of Chinese text image super-resolution. And the new method has better performance in PSNR/SSIM metrics and can effectively restore blurred low-resolution images into clear high-resolution images.

articleTitle: Research on Microblog Sentiment Analysis Based on Multimodal and Multiscale Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The pneumonia epidemic spread by the 2019 new coronavirus(2019-nCoV) has affected people's lives in any aspects, and has aroused widespread concern in global public opinion. In order to better grasp the real public opinion situation on the Internet and ensure the progress of epidemic prevention and public opinion analysis, this paper conducts research on netizen sentiment analysis for epidemic-related topics in the Internet community, and proposes a multimodal feature fusion solution. For the fusion of image and text modalities, Bi-LSTM and Bi-GRU are used to further learn the intrinsic correlation between modalities on the basis of bidirectional transformer feature fusion, and an image-based multi-scale feature fusion method is proposed, which can better solve the problem in this task. Experiments show that the method proposed in this paper is better than the current mainstream multimodal sentiment analysis methods.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction of Power Electronics Module based on RELM-AdaBoost
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper introduces the extreme learning machine (ELM) optimization theory based on the regularization coefficient, and the framework and theory of AdaBoost integrated learning algorithm. A fault prediction method based on RELM-AdaBoost is proposed. For insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT), a standard power unit in power electronics, the monitoring data of the module is collected by accelerating degradation experiment to form a data set. We carry out the remaining useful life (RUL) prediction experiment of the IGBT module with the method proposed in this paper. The experimental results show that the RELM-AdaBoost model can reasonably predict the remaining practical life of the IGBT module under overload conditions. The prediction curve of RUL is consistent with the actual fault occurrence. The approach in this article can support subsequent evaluation and maintenance decisions.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm-based Reproduction of Certainty Effect: From the perspective of survival environments
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the certainty effect is modeled from the perspective of the survival environment. The SEGA algorithm, based on the python geatpy library, reproduces the social experiment designed by Kahneman et al. to demonstrate the correlation between the survival environment and the certainty effect. This paper takes the opportunity to point out that the more demanding the survival environment is, the more likely it is to lead to a certainty effect.

articleTitle: Research on Protection of Power System Information Communication Network Security
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As the traditional power grid is gradually integrated into an intelligent and networked smart IoT grid, 5G communication technology provides strong support for the construction of the power IoT, but also introduces new security in the application of the power industry. challenge. Based on 5G technology, this paper analyzes the current 5G networking deployment scheme, and analyzes its security and cost. A health assessment system for network security risks enables the construction of 5G smart grids.

articleTitle: A PV-DM-based feature fusion method for binary malware clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Utilizing NLP methods in malware classification or clustering applications is a hotspot in malware analysis. Binary malware embedding has become an important direction and basis for malware analysis. Existing binary malware vectorizing methods cannot extract semantic and functional information simultaneously, which may affect the performance of family clustering. In this paper, a novel feature fusion representation method is proposed based on PV -DM (Paragraph Vector-Distributed Memory) model, and the K-Means algorithm is adopted for family clustering. The method combines the features of program-level API call sequence and function-level instruction sequences by means of PV -DM. The functional and semantic representation capabilities of binary malwares can be improved. Malware public dataset VXHeavon is taken as the dataset. A series of experiments are conducted, using the existing family labels as the clustering accuracy evaluation standard. The results demonstrate that our feature fusion representation method outperforms the baseline method by 4.96% in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Following by UWB Sensors and High-precision Gyroscope for Industrial Assistance Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Assistance robots are popular implemented in many industrial automatic manufactures. In particular, instead of carrying heavy object by hand, workers utilize industrial assistance robots to deal with non-easy handling stuff. Robots can also assist in completing tasks well when the goods need to be sent to a production workshop. Usually robots need to follow people to reach the destination. In this process, a robust adaptive following is necessarily used. Many previous researches were focused on vision-tracking following approaches or line tracking method for designing autonomous following. However, vision-tracking following is limited by light environment and line tracking method is only used in specific route. This paper proposed a novel following method combined UWB Sensors (Ultra-Wideband Sensors) and high-precision gyroscope to track and follow the target. When sensitivity of UWB Sensors declines because of the complex dynamic environment, high-precision gyroscope helps robot to identify the target and continue to follow it. The experimental results show that the combination of a variety of sensors and advanced algorithms could effectively deal with the problem caused by few sensors following method and achieve robust adaptive following in dynamic environment.

articleTitle: Fault Detection Method of Wireless Sensor Network by Using Improved Self-Organizing Map and Trend Correlation Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN s) deployed in harsh environments are prone to sensor node failures, which result in faulty data included in sensing data and reduce the availability and reliability of WSNs. Accordingly, one WSN fault detection method is proposed in this paper by combining the improved Self- Organizing Map (SOM) and Trend Correlation Detection (TCD), which is abbreviated as SOM- TCD. This paper firstly improves the traditional SOM and uses it to cluster the sensor nodes in WSN into clusters according to the correlation between their sensing data, and then uses TCD to process the intra-cluster sensing data to achieve more efficient fault detection. This paper considers four typical WSN fault types, and compares the proposed method with several existing methods through experiments. The experimental results denote that the fault detection performance of the proposed method is more ideal under all scenarios of different fault injection rates, and its detection accuracy rate can be greater than 90%. In most cases, the detection accuracy rate of the proposed method is better than those comparison methods.

articleTitle: OEmoBERTa: Only Using Emotion for Emotion Recognition in Conversation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the universal application of human-computer interaction systems in people's life, users' requirements for the performance of these systems are gradually improving. For example, when a user uses a smart speaker, they want it to recommend music according to their moods. When treating a patient, if the medical machine can read the current mood of patients and give comfort, it can help doctors complete treatment more efficiently. When users chat with the chatbot, they wish that the robot can feel their emotions and make personalized responses. In order to meet the needs of users and provide them with good services, researchers put a lot of energy on the development of human-computer interaction system. This also makes the number of available public datasets for emotion recognition gradually increase, and more and more scholars put forward their own optimization ideas and developed new models according to the developed models. Thus, in order to make the chatbot respond flexibly according to user's emotion, this research, through improving on the basis of EmoBERTa model, aims to develop a suitable model for this field. Experiments show that the performance of the model is better than other models, the method of reducing input segment makes the prediction time faster than the original model, and the addition of emotion increases the accuracy. The experimental results also confirmed how much the speaker's own emotions can affect the outcome of emotion prediction.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Montgomery Modular Multiplier Based on KO-3 Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the public-key cryptographic algorithms like RSA and ECC algorithms, the modular multiplier is the basic and frequently used operation. The core of the modular multiplier is the large integer multiplication. In this paper, we firstly propose a design of multicycle 258-bit KO-3 multiplication based on deduced Karatsuba-Ofman algorithm and further apply this multiplication in the 256-bit pipeline Montgomery modular multiplier. The design is implemented with Verilog hardware description language and we get the synthesis report with Synopsys Design Compiler under SMIC 65nm library. Our design runs a Montgomery modular multiplier in 17 clock cycles and the total latency is 37.4ns. The area of the design is 145281 um2 approximately. Compared with other designs under the same library, our design costs less area and power and can balance the delay-area at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Control Strategy of Energy-saving Power Supply System of 5G Communication Base Station
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of large scale and many branches in the current power grid, a wide coverage and large connection access method is needed to meet its ubiquitous communication needs. However, the commercial use of 5G technology has high energy consumption, resulting in greater loss of energy transmission. This paper firstly analyzes the current loss of energy consumption in the base station computer room of the 5G power grid, analyzes the loss generated by the 5G networking scheme, and proposes a routing priority-based decision-making algorithm and a DCI-based signal energy saving to reduce the power loss of power grid energy. The construction of energy-saving and efficient 5G power grid is empowered.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Power Generation Power Prediction Method Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Due to the influence of many high random factors on the new energy power generation system, the electric energy output by the generator is extremely unstable, which increases the difficulty of predicting the power generation. Traditional power generation forecasting methods are highly dependent on data, and the accuracy of the forecast results is largely affected by the integrity of the data. Therefore, it is necessary to study new energy generation power forecasting methods. Technological progress in the field of machine learning and artificial intelligence has provided an effective way for new energy power generation power prediction and a convenient method to improve the prediction accuracy. According to the mechanism characteristics of new energy power generation system, this paper analyzes the feasibility of machine learning algorithm to deal with the problem of new energy power generation power prediction; studies various models and algorithms related to power system power prediction; proposes a new energy power generation power prediction based on deep learning algorithm model, and use the historical data of a new energy power station in a certain place for simulation. The simulation results show that the machine learning algorithm model can significantly reduce the prediction error and improve the accuracy of power generation prediction.

articleTitle: Safety Helmet Wearing Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current safety helmet detection methods are easy to miss and false detect small objects and occluded objects in crowded scene, a lightweight safety helmet detection method based on YOLOX was proposed. Firstly, the coordinate attention mechanism is added into YOLOX backbone network to improve the network's perception of object position. Secondly, a weighted bidirectional feature pyramid was used to replace the feature fusion part of the neck network to achieve simple and fast multi-scale feature fusion, and depthwise separable convolution is used to reduce the number of parameters of the network and model size. Finally, a new detection scale is added to further strengthen the detection ability of small objects. On the helmet wearing detection dataset SHWD, the experimental results show that the mAP of the improved method reaches 92.2%, which is improved by 2.34% compared with the original algorithm, and the model size is reduced by 16%. The missed detection and false detection of small objects and occluded objects are improved.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling and Evaluation of Wireless Communication System Based on FTA
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: System failure mode and cause analysis are the basis for studying system reliability. Aiming at the difficulties existing in the process of reliability quantitative analysis, such as the large number of wireless communication system devices and the complex failure distribution, this paper proposes a reliability modeling and evaluation method for wireless communication systems based on fault tree analysis. On the basis of the fault tree analysis method, the fault tree model and the fault tree probability composition function of the wireless communication system are established. Through the qualitative analysis of the fault tree, the minimum cut set of the fault tree is solved, the type of equipment failure distribution is refined, the appropriate index parameters are selected to quantitatively evaluate the reliability, and the test and analysis are carried out in combination with the experimental data.

articleTitle: Multi-scale perturbation fusion adversarial attack on MTCNN face detection system
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Researchers have made significant progress in fake face image detection in recent years, which can accurately identify fake face images, but it is still challenging to prevent malicious face-swapping. By analyzing the popular face swap program faceswap, we found that adding perturbations to images to disable face detectors is an effective way to avert face swaps from happening. We propose an adversarial attack method that performs multi-scale interpolating perturbations for the MTCNN face detection system. This method can improve the stability of adversarial samples, resist the perturbation failure caused by scale changes, and achieve attack effects on single and multi-person images while maintaining the cleanliness of images so that images can continue to upload to social media platforms.

articleTitle: Research on Location of Supply Chain Center of Natural Resources based on K-means Clustering Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A good supply chain can improve the overall level of the region. In this paper, we collected several data for each province in mainland China: Such as forest cover, carbon emissions, and the total area of the province, such as data, using the K-means clustering model is analyzed, if the environmental conditions of these provinces' carbon-neutral conditions similar to those of Sihanba around, depending on the province's distance to the centre of the cluster sample to determine whether Sihanba ecological protection model can spread to the region, the shorter the distance, the more similar, It is also suitable for Saihanba ecological protection mode. Through the selection of cluster centres and several iterations, we divided all the provinces on the mainland into three clusters. This research is helpful to select the location of supply chain center between cities.

articleTitle: Design and Motion Simulation of Dragonfly-like Wings
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to study the bionic dragonfly wings, based on the existing structure of the plane single crank double rocker mechanism, a mechanism similar to the crank slider double rocker rod is used, and SOLIDWORKS is used to model and design it. In the design of the bionic dragonfly wing, ANSYS is used to perform static and modal finite element analysis on the determined mathematical model of the wing. We determine through static force analysis that the maximum principal stresses of the front and rear wings are 73.78MPa and 90.87MPa, respectively. Its position is the rear side of the wing root of the airfoil, where it is necessary to appropriately increase the thickness to improve the strength of the wing. At the same time, the first-order natural frequencies of the front wing and rear wing of the bionic dragonfly are also analyzed to be 15.97 Hz and 16.56 Hz, respectively. Finally, ADAMS is used to simulate the motion of the designed flapping wing mechanism, and the maximum flapping angle is 70 degrees, the upper flapping angle of the front and rear wings are about 33 degrees, and the lower flapping angle is about 37 degrees. The main stage of the flapping-wing generating lift accounts for about 53 % of the whole process, indicating that the designed flapping-wing mechanism moves smoothly and stably, meets the design requirements of the imitation dragonfly flapping-wing aircraft, and satisfies that the phase difference between the front wing and the rear wing is 90 degrees. Compared with traditional Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), the bionic dragonfly UAV has high flexibility, compact structure, low noise and stable operation, which provides an important parameter basis for the design of advanced bionic aircraft, and is of great significance for its practical application.

articleTitle: Crowd Counting Model with Convolutional Neural Networks and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Crowd counting means calculating the crowd density of the current scene. In modern society, the study on crowd counting is of great significance. This paper focuses on multi-view crowd counting, using multi-view images to predict crowd density and crowd distribution of the current scene. This paper proposes a crowd counting model with convolutional neural networks and transformer, which uses the same view branch to extract features with images from various views. The feature maps will be projected and fused in the same world space, then the scene-level feature maps are regressed to a scene-level density map. This paper does experiments on the PETS2009 and CityStreet datasets. Numerous experiments have proven that our method has good accuracy, especially for dense small objects.

articleTitle: The Integrated Design of Millimeter Wave Insert Fed Circular Microstrip Patch Antenna and Radome
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: An integrated design method of millimeter wave (MMW) insert fed circular microstrip patch antenna and radome is proposed to solve the problem of deteriorating orientation distortion and low sensitivity of the system. Firstly, the parameters of the circular microstrip patch antenna are calculated based on the cavity model theory. Then the shape of the radome is designed by using the theory of single-layer half-wave radome. Finally, the integrated modeling and optimization design of the Radome and the antenna is carried out by using the 3D full-wave electromagnetic simulation software HFSS, the integrated design of Ka Band insert fed millimeter wave circular microstrip patch antenna and Radome is realized. The simulation results show that the integrated design of the single-layer half-wave Radome and the Ka-band insert fedmillimeter circular microstrip patch antenna has resonant operating frequency of 34.5 GHz, gain of 6.69 dB, E-plane beam width is 116°, H-plane beam width is 100°, and when the thickness of the radome is half-wave thickness and the height is higher than half-wave length, the radome has the least effect on the return loss and antenna pattern.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Deep Learning RF Fingerprint Recognition Method
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Current deep learning-based RF fingerprint recognition methods have the problems of large models and high operational complexity, for which this paper proposes an RF fingerprint recognition method (CNN-GRU network) using a combination of convolutional neural networks and gated recurrent unit networks. The algorithm uses a convolutional layer to extract IQ orthogonal correlation features and learning temporal data, then extracts temporal features through the GRU network, and finally has an output layer to output recognition results. The number of parameters of the algorithm is reduced by using small convolutional kernels and replacing multiple fully connected layers with gated cyclic units. Experimental results show that the algorithm achieves a recognition rate of 98.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> on a software radio dataset with multiple USRP X310s, and the algorithm has fewer parameters and is more lightweight than network models with the same recognition rate, which is of better engineering application.

articleTitle: A Network Topology Discovery Algorithm Based on IS-IS
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Efficiently, accurately and automatically discovering the network topology is an important research content of network measurement. This paper analyses the hierarchical structure of IS-IS protocol and the types and functions of LSP. Then topological relationship analytical methods based on LSP information are studied. For the shortcomings of the current algorithm, a network topology discovery algorithm of heuristic judgment based on LSP information is designed. Finally, by experimenting typical network layout scenario, the effectiveness and correctness of the algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Soft Fault Detection in Sensor Networks by Using Graph-embedded LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Due to the uncertain working environment and resource constraints, sensor nodes easily produce abnormal responds, resulting in various kinds of soft faults. Existing studies often solely focus on the soft fault diagnosis of individual sensor node, ignoring the possible impact of the spatial relationship between sensor nodes. This paper cooperatively uses the temporal and spatial correlations of sensor data, and proposes a soft fault detection method named as Graph-embedded Long Short-Term Memory AutoEncoder (GLSTM-AE), which is an AE model based on the combination of Graph Attention Network (GAT) and LSTM Network. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms several typical traditional methods. On the experimental dataset, both the Area Under Curve (AUC) of the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) and the Average Precision (AP) of the proposed method are greater than 0.95, and the F1 score is best as well as.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Congestion Control for Delay-Sensitive Multimedia Streaming
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet and the dawn of the 5G age, more and more creative network services and applications are pouring out. Some of these applications are delay-sensitive, requiring the data to arrive within the specific acceptable end-to-end latency (i.e., meeting deadline), such as Metaverse, cloud VR gaming, and autonomous driving. These applications have brought new challenges to ensuring users' QoE(quality-of-experience). To achieve high bandwidth and acceptable end-to-end latency and improve the QoE of these delay-sensitive applications. We proposed SAC-CC (Soft Actor-Critic based Congestion Control), which combines a deep reinforcement learning method to solve the poor performance of the heuristic congestion control algorithms when delay-sensitive multimedia streaming is transmitted. SAC-CC can also adapt to the complex network state. We also design a new framework based on the SAC framework and utilize GRU and self-attention networks for SAC-CC. The new framework can extract more historical information to improve the robustness and stability of SAC-CC. Experimental results show that SAC-CC performs well in various scenarios and outperforms other baseline algorithms.

articleTitle: Combat network evaluation of equipment system using complex network and comprehensive weighting method
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The equipment system is a complex giant system, an integration of weapon systems. Based on the complex network theory, this paper innovatively adopts the threshold method of communication times to abstract and model the equipment combat system. The connectivity, stability and aggregation characteristics of the equipment system network are measured by statistics such as node, degree, path length, and clustering coefficient. On this basis, a comprehensive weighting method combining AHP and EWM is used to determine the weight of each characteristic index, so as to realize the overall evaluation of the combat network characteristics of the equipment system. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the evaluation method are verified by an example of warship system.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of Wi-Fi Band-pass Filter with Symmetrical Zeros
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The basic theory of band-pass filter is introduced, and a RF WIFI band-pass filter is designed by using radio-frequency/microwave software which is named ADS on the basis of theoretical calculations and analysis. Symmetrical zeros are respectively introduced at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${2000}\mathbf{MHz}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${2900}\mathbf{MHz}$</tex> out of band to realize the rapid decline of out of band suppression, and better eliminate out of band interference and improve the anti-interference ability of the communication system. In the common frequency band range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${2400}\sim {2500}\mathbf{MHz}$</tex>, the standing wave ratio is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\leq 1.21}$</tex>, the return loss is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${> 20}\mathbf{dB}$</tex> and the insertion loss is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${<} {1.8}\mathbf{dB}$</tex>. It is used in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other communication systems, has good anti-interference ability and can improve the noise coefficient of the communication system, and can improve the communication distance of the communication system. The difference between theoretical design and simulation software design is compared. The theoretical calculation is cumbersome and complex, while the simulation software design is simple, efficient, fast and convenient for tuning. This method can be used in the design of other RF filters as low-pass RF filters and high-pass RF filters.

articleTitle: Iterative recovery algorithm for Incomplete and Phase-Corrupted micro-Doppler signals in real-time
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In micro-motion signal processing, incomplete and phase-corrupted radar echoes result in bad time-frequency representation and thus prevent the extraction of micro-motion features. To solve the problem, the optimization model is developed to reconstruct phase-corrupted and incomplete m-D signals. The optimization model is solved through an alternating iteration algorithm. In each iteration, the recovery signal and the phase error are updated by the alternating direction method of multipliers and the least-squares theory, respectively. For m-D signal real-time processing to save radar time resources, the received signal can be directly sparse recovered real-rather than waiting for the complete signal. Additionally, the statistics of patch offsets are applied to construct the termination condition. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated from the simulation results.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-point Heating Equipment Control Based on Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the concept of carbon neutralization advocated by the Chinese government and the fact that cities in northern China generally adopt the centralized heating mode of direct coal combustion and thermoelectric networking, and many old communities have the phenomenon of high cost and difficulty in heating transformation, this paper proposes a design of multi-point heating equipment control based on wireless communication, which combines wireless remote communication technology Lora, STM32 microcontroller, A variety of Internet of things acquisition sensor technology and PID control algorithm. This design can not only help alleviate the pressure of heating transformation in old communities, but also actively respond to China's concept of carbon neutrality.

articleTitle: A New 3d Face Recognition Method Based on Combined Category Information
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of existing face recognition that there are changes in face pose or changes in light intensity and angle, it is impossible to make full use of the training sample category information for training, resulting in recognition errors. The image feature space decomposition and extraction in this paper adopts the combined category information. The non-negative matrix factorization method can make full use of the category information of training samples and improve the recognition performance. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional non-negative matrix factorization method, the method adopted in this paper has better improvement and promotion in the effectiveness of feature extraction and face recognition rate.

articleTitle: A Fine-Grained Recognition Model Based On Hippocampal Neural Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Fine-grained image recognition tasks have received much attention in recent years. Works in this fields generally suffers from the following drawbacks: firstly, models are designed to be overly bloated due to the incorporation of multiple less relevant solutions, secondly, the feature map-based design methods ignore the characteristics of the feature vectors themselves, and thirdly, they lack a comprehensive consideration of the semantic relationships of the categories. In this paper, a brain-inspired modelling framework is proposed to model the neural circuits of hippocampal. The TSP module simulates situational memory, uncovering image properties, by interacting with pairs of sample features, while the MSP module simulates statistical learning, forming overlapping representations, by optimizing the spatial distribution of the samples' feature states. The work in this paper integrates the semantic information embedded in feature vectors to generate discriminative representations in terms of their universal nature. Experimental results show that the model in this paper is effective in public benchmarks and can be a complementary alternative to other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Transfer-based Few-Shot Learning on SAR Target recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the study of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) target recognition, few-shot recognition is a valuable area for further research. To make full use of the available SAR data, this paper proposes a multi-ghost extractor with maximum a posteriori (MGMAP) estimates algorithm based on the principle of transfer learning. The feature extractor is trained by constructing a base dataset using additional datasets. The trained feature extractor extracts the features of the samples in the novel dataset and, after pre-processing, the features are transformed into a Gaussian distribution. The samples in the novel dataset are randomly selected to construct the meta-learning task. A Sinkhorn iterative algorithm based on the Wass distance metric is used to update the MAP estimates at the center, resulting in the classification results. Experimental results on the MSTAR dataset demonstrate that the MGMAP achieves recognition rates of up to 71.15% for 5way-1shot and 80.74% for 5way-10shot in the small sample learning task, far exceeding other classical algorithms. This can be migrated to different tasks with high adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Evaluation Model of Garment Assembly Line Layout Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To evaluate whether a garment assembly line orchestration scheme is feasible is a problem that garment enterprises must face. In response to this problem, this paper introduces the process and method of garment assembly line arrangement, combined with the actual situation of a garment factory, and gives a specific case. Based on this case, a simulation system for the feasibility evaluation of the orchestration scheme is designed and implemented. This paper proposes the orchestration scheme, key technologies, modeling methods, and the evaluation process and implementation of the choreography evaluation simulation system of the clothing assembly line.

articleTitle: Motion Prediction for Autonomous Vehicles Based on EfficientNet-B1
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Perception, decision-making, and planning and control are the three cores of autonomous vehicles, enabling the vehicle to perceive and understand the driving environment, make active decisions, perform real-time path planning on the global or local map, accurately control vehicle motion, and track the desired trajectory. In this way, the desired driving requirements are achieved. In our paper, we use EfficientNet to predict autonomous vehicles' motion. We calculate the negative log-likelihood of the ground truth data given the multi-modal predictions. to evaluate our model's performance, we compare our model with ResNet50 and ResNet34 using same loss and same dataset. From the compared experiments, EfficientNet method owns the lowest loss 11.37. In contrast, the other methods like ResNext50, ResNet34's accuracy are 23.58, 23.62 respectively.

articleTitle: Aircraft Spatial Signal Testing Method Based on Big Data Driven Self-Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The aircraft spatial signal map is used to discern whether the aircraft signal meets the system operating requirements. The traditional acquisition of aircraft spatial signal direction map relies on test flights, and the data obtained can only plot two-dimensional directional map of aircraft signals. Given that such approach will incur high cost, long time and incomplete data, this paper proposes a novel technical route to acquire aircraft spatial signals by utilizing big data driven self-learning technology. Using neural networks and fuzzy algorithm for data processing, the data-based method is able to improve the measurement accuracy of the aircraft spatial signal, save test flight cost, promote overhaul of the aircraft communication system and maintain aircraft flight safety.

articleTitle: The Operating Speed Difference Model of Atlas Platform Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Orbit-free density functional theory is expected to become an ideal theoretical method for large-scale quantum mechanical simulation because it can well balance computational accuracy and speed in large-scale system simulation. With the development of kinetic energy density functionals and localized pseudopotentials, orbit-free density functional theory is also expected to be applied to large-scale simulations. However, further development of efficient and stable corresponding software is required for the widespread application of orbit-free density functional theory. This paper develops an orbit-free density functional theory package ATLAS based on the real-space finite difference method. It uses the numerical stability of its direct energy minimization algorithm, through the simulation test of some periodic systems of Mg, Al, and Al3Mg, and the comparison with the calculation results of PROFESS software package based on orbital density functional theory and CASTEP software package based on KS density functional theory. It is shown that this technology can achieve accurate and stable numerical results in large-scale calculation simulation, which can provide a new choice for scarce calculation simulation software based on orbital density functional theory, and is expected to promote the broader application of orbital density functional theory in the large-scale calculation simulation field.

articleTitle: A Design of Ku-Band Dual-Axe Shaped Microstrip Antenna with Two Slots
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The Ku-band is used as a communication band between satellites, such as Tracking and Data Relay (TDRS) satellites for the International Space Station and Space Shuttle communications. In the field of satellite broadcasting, Ku-band is also a commonly-used band. This paper presents a design of a Ku-band dual-axe shaped microstrip antenna with semi-open slots. The design methodology and simulation results are given in the paper. The major function frequency of this antenna was 15.1 GHz, with the bandwidths for antenna return loss of -10 dB and -15 dB were 1.26 GHz and 0.66 GHz. Furthermore, the main lobe magnitudes of the working function was 6.35 dBi. The gain of the antenna was higher than 6.0 dBi from 13.9 GHz to 16.3 GHz.

articleTitle: Underwater go-back channel statistical model research of reflection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Underwater communication is enormous severely disturbed by ocean channel especially under particular background of transceiver combination. The paper aimed to use trial data to invert contained parameters and propose underwater go-back channel model with reflected signal fluctuation on statistical field. And basing on M - H in Bayes- MCMC sampling algorithm, the paper both analyzed parameter inversion characteristics of go-back channel model, and adopted trial data of SNR=1dB, 6dB conditions to simulate and verify. The simulation result showed that small diversity indicating established inversion model effective and owning vital significance for underwater device communication.

articleTitle: Intelligent Classification System for Recyclables based on Image and Acoustic Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: It is of great significance to classify garbage through deep learning and image processing technology to realize garbage recycling and resource reuse. We propose a garbage classification system based on improved Faster R-CNN with audio-visual combination to achieve higher classification accuracy. We have introduced a new deep learning based system to effectively combine image and sound features for garbage classification. Based on this model, we implement an automatic garbage classification program with a graphical interface. We tried to add transparency and audio features for garbage sorting. The result shows that our method has high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of Direct Coupled and Small Volume Filter for 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The design theory of the filter is introduced. Based on the theoretical calculation and analysis, a 5G system cavity filter is designed by using the RF/microwave simulation software HFSS. The relationship between the length of the resonant rod and the frequency, the relationship between the spacing of the resonant rod and the coupling coefficient, and the influence of the input and output ports on the external Q value are analyzed. The overall filter is simulated and optimized. The results show that, the volume of the filter is 52<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sup>8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sup>12mm, in the pass-band (3.4 GHz~3.5 GHz), the insertion loss is less than 0.3dB; the return loss is more than 29dB, which is far better than the indicators of similar devices. When used in 5G communication system, it can improve the noise figure of the system, the communication distance and capacity, the stability of the communication system, and the experience of 5G users.

articleTitle: Research on Partition Machining of Double Robot Polishing Free-form Surface Based on Point Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of unbalanced task distribution in the double-robot polishing process, resulting in low processing efficiency and poor precision. In this paper, the segmentation of the workpiece surface is carried out based on the point cloud. First, triangulate the point cloud, and then the curvature and normal vectors of each triangle centre are obtained,starting with the minimum curvature and growing through the normal vector difference and curvature difference to obtain a coarsely divided area of the workpiece surface. Secondly, by calculating the Euclidean distance between each point of the workpiece and the center of the sphere in the workspace, and comparing it with the radius, the subdivision of the area is completed. It provides good conditions for the subsequent dual robot polishing task assignment and motion planning research.

articleTitle: Blind Image Super-Resolution by improved HR-Net with fused Residual Connections
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Super-resolution is an important task in computer vision, which intuitively increases the resolution of images, thereby enriching the information in images. In the current superresolution models, fully fusion and exchange of shallow information and deep information of the original image is lacking, as well as the information of the original image is insufficiently utilized. The HR-Net structure retains the information of the original image for a long time, and can conduct sufficient information interaction between different scales simultaneously. Besides, the residual connection, as one of the most commonly used structures, can accelerate the model convergence and preserve the original information of the data well. Taking these ideas into account, this paper proposes a super-resolution method based on HR-Net structure and residual connection, and adds a global residual connection on the base structure of HR-Net, which further preserves the original image information. The method was validated on Set5, Set10, Urban100 and B100 datasets, respectively. Experiments show that this method enriches the details of restored high-resolution images, especially on Set5, and outper-forms most classical methods

articleTitle: Automatic Attitude Test System for Rotary Steerable Tool
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: There are problems such as a long data acquisition cycle, high test cost, and uncontrollable factors in manual testing for the traditional attitude algorithm verification process. Also, the test can not go through all attitude positions. The design of an automatic attitude test system is proposed, and it can realize the automatic control of the virtual while drilling sensor and the signal acquisition of the main controller. The test consists of static and dynamic measurement methods, the communication with the main controller is realized through RS485, and the data is acquired and then uploaded to the GUI interface of the automated test system. After verification, the system can modify the step length by setting the attitude, completing the attitude's 100% full coverage test, and verifying the attitude acquisition end of the main controller. The interface is simple to operate, and the automation program is high, which can effectively solve the attitude data. The test cycle is long, and the problem of manual error is easy.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Laser Filling Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The laser marking technology integrates Laser Technology, Computer Technology and Mechatronics Technology. In this paper, we design the sawtooth parallel trajectory generation algorithm, the contour parallel trajectory generation algorithm and the pixel model algorithm for the laser marking trajectory model. For three different marking modes, this paper compares and discusses the time-consuming situation of their respective algorithms. Based on the sawtooth parallel traj ectory generation algorithm, this paper proposes that finding the best angle of the workpiece can significantly improve the efficiency of the algorithm and make the marking path more efficient.

articleTitle: Research on FAST Working Mechanism Based on Vertex Optimization Model and Reflective Panel Adjustment Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to meet the observation requirements of the FAST radio telescope for celestial bodies with different angles, on the premise of considering the constraints such as the adjustment range and deformation amplitude of the reflection panel, the expansion and contraction of the actuator is adjusted to control the main cable node to make the working paraboloid as close as possible to the ideal paraboloid. In order to determine the ideal paraboloid when the observation object S is above the reference sphere, by analyzing the working mechanism of the reflection panel, a vertex optimization model is established with the optimal value of paraboloid vertex offset has the objective and the radial adjustment range of the actuator as the constraint. When modelling, it is the key to judge whether the displacement direction of the actuator and the lower cable is collinear, which can make the expansion and contraction of the main cable node more realistic and more accurate than that obtained in collinear condition. Next, a reflection panel adjustment model is established to solve the expansion and contraction of the actuator, and the reflection panel is adjusted to be close to the ideal paraboloid. Then, a telescopic optimization model is established, which aims at the optimal expansion d of the main cable node. It also takes the change range of the distance between adjacent nodes before and after adjusting the main cable node as the constraint condition.

articleTitle: Research on an intelligent non-inductive sign for receipt method for special logistics
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The survey found that special logistics have strict requirements on people, locations, goods, etc. in the sign for receipt and handover process. With the continuous improvement of people's living quality, under such strict requirements, the cost for suppliers to standardize the sign for receipt process by adopting the method of “paper receipt + manual receipt” is also increasing, and it is impossible to effectively supervise the actual sign for receipt process, which is very unfavorable to the development of the industry. In view of the above problems, through the analysis of the standardized operation process and demand of the sign for receipt site, we focus on the research on video segmentation, image processing, intelligent recognition, etc., a set of intelligent non-inductive sign for receipt scheme based on B/S framework is designed, which integrates intelligent sign for receipt and data management.
