Through the test operation, the plan can effectively improve the supervision level and service quality of distribution, while reducing the cost of distribution labor and consumables, and meet the prevention and control requirements of “contactless distribution” proposed in the normalization stage of the current epidemic.

articleTitle: Detecting Non-control-flow Hijacking Threats with Deep Autoencoding Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Non-control-flow hijacking attacks have been an emerging threat for current computer system security. Attackers leverage data manipulation in memory to corrupt the integrity of the target program without invalidating the normal control-flow during execution. Consequently, current sandox-based methods towards mitigating control-oriented attacks cannot identify non-control-flow hijacking attacks. In this paper, we proposed a data-driven methology to distinguish the abnormity for non-control-flow hijacking detection. We adopt a deep autoencoding gaussian mixture model architecture that leverages the hardware events and corresponding contextual information during execution. The proposed framework has shown an outstanding performance through comparative experiments with previous literatured works.

articleTitle: Stochastic Markov $k$-Tree Network Sparsification Learning for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Classification in computer science is for the purpose of designing and implementing an algorithmic classifier to identify the target category given by an observed data, which has played a key role within the recent decades. The author, in this paper, proposed a novel image classification learning method associated with machine learning by introducing network sparsification modelling algorithm based on stochastic Markov k-tree graph learning. The proposed Markov k-tree network sparsification learning demonstrated its overall state-of-art performance, as our testing and analysis proved, on multiple datasets which are generally well-used for the image classification application.

articleTitle: Power Equipment Life Prediction Method Based on Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the expansion of the scale of the smart grid and the increasing demand for power supply reliability of the power system, there is a more stringent and accurate demand for the maintenance of power equipment. Therefore, it is of great significance to formulate a reasonable and efficient maintenance plan to prevent accidents and save the cost of power grid operation and maintenance. In this paper, the function suitable for the changing trend of the failure rate of power equipment is selected as the calculation model of the failure rate of power equipment. The weight of clustering parameters is introduced to analyze the influence of maintenance on equipment failure rate. The parameters of degradation modeling are estimated based on the failure data of power equipment. The calculation model of the failure rate of power equipment based on the degradation model is established. In the experimental analysis, the statistical data of power equipment failure is used for example analysis, and the parameters in the fitting degradation model function are used so that the calculation method is simpler, and the failure rate obtained is more objective.

articleTitle: State Estimation of Initiating Explosive Device Based on Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The initiating explosive warhead system in this paper is a nonlinear system, and the ordinary filter is difficult to estimate the rotation state of the warhead. Therefore, the extended Kalman filter is used to estimate the system state in this paper. The third-order state space equation of the initiating explosive drive system is established. The warhead rotation angle is taken as the measured value, and the signal-to-noise ratio before and after filtering is taken as the measurement standard of the filtering estimation effect. The experimental results show that the extended Kalman filter can effectively estimate the rotation state of the initiating explosive drive system.

articleTitle: Improved Anomaly Detection based on Loss Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the field of anomaly detection, it is challenging to collect and annotate enough samples of anomalies. Unsupervised learning is therefore frequently employed in anomaly detection and localization. The existing deep learning models for anomaly detection leverage various loss functions to train the neural networks, and they have achieved excellent performance. However, these methods are only aware of the function that loss values serve in back-propagation, but ignore that the loss value itself can partially represent how anomalous the input sample is. Consequently, we proposed a novel framework that constructs a network branch for loss prediction based on an anomaly detection network, i.e. the base model. This loss prediction branch predicts the loss value in forward-propagation, and the predicted loss value is further integrated with the output of the base model for more accurate anomaly detection. On the MVTec AD dataset, the experimental results reveal that the proposed framework outperforms other mainstreaming methods. The proposed framework can achieve AUC metrics of 98.1 % at the pixel level and 99.5% at the image level, which are 0.2% and 0.4 % higher than the base model, respectively.

articleTitle: A 5G NTN-RAN Implementation Architecture with Security
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: At the 3GPP TSG#96 meeting held in Budapest in June 2022, 3GPP announced 5G Release 17 finalization. The prioritized areas of new radio (NR) over non-terrestrial networks (NTN), internet of things (loT) over NTN, and satellite modules in the 5G architecture are embraced. Relating to the three types of NTN payloads of transparency, full gNB (New Generation NodeB) on board and gNB-DU (Distributed Unit) on board, this paper focused on the architecture implementation of the third option building on 3GPP standards, this network deployment scenario is extremely eligible to form satellite constellations, with its security issues of authentication and key distribution, confidentiality, and integrity. The Fl interface over satellite radio interface (SRI) between gNB-DU embarking on satellite and gNB-CU (Central Unit) are introduced together with secure protocols and cryptographic algorithms applied. In the future, as 3GPP Release 18 starts making stage freeze process and the rapid development of commercialized quantum computers with adapted algorithms, this paper also touches on the new protocols and cryptographic algorithms applying to the forthcoming 5G NTN system at large.

articleTitle: Maximization-Minimization Secrecy Capacity Optimization Algorithm Based on Intelligent Reflecting Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the communication security of the system in practical scenario, a maximization-minimization secrecy capacity optimization algorithm is proposed in the paper with the aid of intelligent reflecting surface (IRS). A scheme of physical layer security design based on alternative iteration was proposed for a multi-input and single-output (MISO) IRS- assisted secure wireless communications with multiple eavesdroppers. At the same time, a nonlinear and multivariate coupled secrecy capacity maximization model is formulated with the consideration of the maximum power at the base station (BS) and the continuous phase shift constraints at IRS. Then the Dinkelbach algorithm is adopted to transform the non-convex problem into a series of solvable subproblems and the alternative iteration method is applied to achieve the optimization of the beamforming vector at BS and phase-shifting matrix at IRS. Compared with the traditional schemes, the algorithm proposed lowers the computational complexity of the communication system and converges quickly.

articleTitle: Research on industrial Internet Platform Technology based on machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Industrial Internet, is a new generation of information technology and industrial system full range of deep integration of the product, mainly for the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry, can greatly boost the development of productivity, to pull the real economy has an important role. However, as the industrial Internet is an emerging industry, its development and construction experience and capacity are still in the initial stage. The report to the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China made it clear that we will promote the deep integration of the Internet, big data, artificial intelligence and the real economy. After the financial crisis, the manufacturing industry once again became the focus of global attention. With the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry, the industrial Internet platform based on cloud computing, big data, Internet of Things, artificial intelligence and other new generation of information technology emerged. With the development of machine learning and deep learning, machine learning models such as genetic algorithm and gradient optimization have achieved good results in data classification, regression and fitting. Internet project evaluation based on industry characteristics, puts forward the improved analytic hierarchy process (ahp) based on machine learning methods, and machine learning algorithms and hierarchical analysis method, puts forward a new solution to the problem of the expert scoring to determine judgment matrix and in order to achieve the consistency and accuracy of the algorithm and introduce the weight of the particle swarm algorithm to adjust and sorting, Reduce the inaccuracy and complexity of ahp algorithm in the face of complex problems. To achieve the expert scoring more comprehensive consideration method, as well as more intelligent consistency adjustment and final weight calculation, the index of the industrial Internet design scheme weight calculation, finally according to the scoring scheme and the final hair there are final evaluation scores and further analysis and explanation of the results.

articleTitle: Doubly Robust, Inverse Propensity Score and the Implementation of a More Robust Doubly Robust Estimator in Recommending System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Doubly robust estimation combines a form of outcome regression with a model for the exposure (i.e., the propensity score) to estimate the causal effect of an exposure outcome. More robust doubly robust (MRDR) learns the parameters of the DM model by minimizing the variance of the DR estimator. Even though there are many estimators, but the accuracy level can vary between different estimators, so we explore the problem of reducing bias of different estimators in implicit feedback, including EIB, IPS, DR and MRDR. To evaluate the performance of different estimators, we applied the different estimators to seven different data prediction models. Moreover, we propose our own DB formula and complete the proof and compare it with IPS by calculating the variance.

articleTitle: Image Classification Based on Dual-attention Mechanism and Multi-convolution Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Image classification has always been the core of many people's research, and it is an indispensable and important technology in daily life. In the classification process, the local information of the image largely determines the global features of the image, so finding local pixel features is an indispensable step in the classification. To improve the accuracy of image classification problems, this paper proposes a new model on the premise of ensuring the model is simple and practical. Based on convolutional neural networks, it combines spatial and channel attention mechanisms, with multi-scale convolution operations to quickly and accurately extract key image information. The model is thus able to well capture the key features in the channel and space that determine the image category, thereby improving the classification accuracy. Through testing on multiple datasets and comparing with some mainstream methods, the accuracy of our model has been greatly improved, proving the effectiveness of our method. On the selected flower dataset, the accuracy rate reaches 77%, which is significantly better than other methods. On the rice dataset, the accuracy rate is almost 100%, which greatly improves the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Weighted Average Consensus-Based Unscented Kalman Filtering with Cross-Covariance
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the consensus-based distributed state estimation problem for nonlinear sensor networks. Most existing approaches assume the estimation errors between two connected sensors are independent, and the cross-covariance is neglected in consensus-based distributed unscented Kalman filter (DUKF) frameworks. However, the estimation errors are related considering the joint prior estimates and process noise of the connected nodes. So we propose an improved algorithm to address the problem. At first, the cross-covariances between local estimation error are considered in consensus algorithm. Then, the cross-covariances update in the local unscented Kalman filter (UKF) based on the unscented transformation (UT). Finally, a stochastic nonlinear system is provided to illustrate the advantages of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: When Edge Computing Meets Agile Software Development
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Agile development has been a common methodology in software development. In response to the covid-19, most software development teams choose to work remotely. As a result of the different network environments, the company cloud center network load cannot meet the requirements of remote development and fault tolerance requirements of the agile development process. We designed a mixed-method called the Edge Development approach for improving Agile software development during the decision-making process. The extensive literature review provided us with three categories of challenges as well as solutions to support Edge Development's decision-support process. In the light of the survey, Five main software development decision-making challenges were identified in this study. In addition, we made a series of recommendations to improve the decision-making process of Edge Development from a variety of perspectives.

articleTitle: Real-time Helium Monitoring and Alarm System Based on Epics and Phoebus/Alarms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The Space Environment Simulation and Research Infrastructure (SESRI) is one of the key technologies driving the development of the space industry. The micromechanical analysis subsystem is an important part of SESRI. Helium plays an important role in the start-up, operation, and testing of some of the equipment in the micromechanical analysis subsystem. Once a leak occurs, it is often undetectable to the experimenters. In order to solve the problem of undetectable helium leaks, this paper designs a real-time helium monitoring and alarm system based on Phoebus/Alarms. The monitoring system uses the analog acquisition module of a Siemens CPU S7-300 PLC to collect the analog signals from the helium detector and transmits the corresponding helium measurements to the Input and Output Control (IOC) via the s7nodave device support module. The IOC publishes the data to the Phoebus/Alarms monitoring component via the EPICS Channel Access protocol for visual interface display and OPI human-machine interaction. The system has been tested and found to have good stability and anti-interference properties. It has achieved real-time monitoring and alarming of the helium concentration values in the micromechanical analysis subsystem to meet the monitoring and alarming requirements of the project.

articleTitle: User Access-Oriented Edge Service Scheduling Strategy Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The placement strategy of edge services is mainly designed from the perspectives of cost, resources, energy consumption, time delay and so on. The number of users that can be accessed after the deployment of edge services is ignored, which has a great impact on the deployment effect of edge services and the improvement of overall service quality. According to the changes of users' geographical location and access applications, under the condition of meeting the cost and resource constraints, the overall service quality of the edge is approximately optimal by optimizing the placement strategy. Finally, through simulation experiments, GAGA strategy is compared with similar strategies in detail. The results show that GAGA can show better effect.

articleTitle: Improvement method of low-altitude angle measurement ambiguity of array radar
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Grating lobes will appear in the airspace observation interval when using the maximum likelihood technique to estimate the elevation angle of low-altitude targets. It will lead to poor performance of angle estimation. In view of this problem, this paper analyzes the reasons for the ambiguity of the maximum likelihood estimation. The methods of frequency diversity are introduced into radar elevation angle estimation. The method collects and utilizes more angle information by transmitting signals of different carrier frequencies, which can significantly improve the angle measurement accuracy. Finally, the computer simulation verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A classification algorithm for door and window air tightness detection based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the modern construction technology industry, on-site gas tightness detection is widely used in building doors and Windows, which can reduce unnecessary energy consumption in the application process of building, and achieve energy conservation and emission reduction targets. In order to increase the speed and efficiency of field detection of doors and Windows, this paper proposes a data transmission method based on WIFI wireless transmission, combines the particle swarm with CART algorithm to classify the detection data in real time, and uses this algorithm to optimize CART algorithm to improve the classification accuracy. We demonstrate the effectiveness through numerical simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Application of DIAdem in while-drilling vibration data analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: While-drilling vibration data acquisition module has the characteristics of collecting more data and high acquisition frequency, which leads to the problems of long processing time, low efficiency, and poor visualization in traditional vibration data analysis methods. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes the application of DIAdem in the analysis of while-drilling vibration data. It introduces some powerful functions of DIAdem software in detail. Based on DIAdem software to process while-drilling vibration data, data correction, time-frequency domain analysis, automatic operation can be completed. The processing time is short, high efficiency, and has excellent visualization.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Method of Power Equipment Wireless Body Area Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In view of the defects of the perception Layer in current Ubiquitous power Internet of Things, such as difficulties in internal data acquisition of power equipment, high data transmission costs and insufficient data intelligent processing capabilities, this article introduces the concept of Power Equipment Wireless Body Area Network from the preliminary network architecture design and some communication protocols. Based on above research a low-power consumption communication module is designed and applied in a wireless temperature measurement kit to improve the temperature monitoring ability of intelligent fusion terminal products avoiding fire accidents. According to the product test results the module could provide stable and reliable data transmission which has broad commercial application prospect. This article provides novel reference and exploration for the realization of power distribution automation and energy regulation in the smart grid.

articleTitle: The Survey of Automatic Following Methods of Lower Limb Rehabilitation Robot based on Multi-Source Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For some patients with lower limb mobility, lower limb rehabilitation technology could effectively assist patients to walk and reduce their difficulties in the process of moving. The following method applied to the robot can also provide support to the patient in time when the patient encounters an unexpected situation. In this paper we mainly introduced the development of following methods and two novel following approaches we are focused on. The first one is autonomous following method with piezoresistive films, the second one is robust following method with UWB and high-precision gyroscope. Then we discussed the probability of research about gait detection with EEG in rehabilitation robot.

articleTitle: Two-stage Cross Modal Hashing Retrieval Based on Composite Quantization and Cauchy Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the popularity of Internet applications and the rapid growth of multimodal data, cross-modal retrieval has become one of the key technologies in related fields. Because of the need to handle multi-modal data, cross-modal retrieval consumes a large amount of storage space and retrieval time. In this paper we propose a two-stage cross-modal hash retrieval method based on composite quantization and Cauchy distribution, which is able to learn both hash codes and quantization codes in an end-to-end framework and utilize the two codes successively using a two-stage retrieval mode, thus achieving a reduction in retrieval time while improving retrieval accuracy. Besides, to address the problem of unreasonable distribution of multi-modal data hash codes in Hamming space, cross-modal association loss is improved by using the Cauchy distribution, which can generate higher quality hash codes, resulting in smaller hash code distances for semantically similar objects and larger hash code distances for semantically dissimilar objects, thus improving the overall retrieval effect. The experimental results on MIR-Flickr-25K, MS COCO and IAPR TC-12 dataset demonstrate that our method can effectively improve the cross-modal retrieval performance.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional Localization of Correlated Source Based on Optimized OLS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To improve the localization accuracy of covariance matrix fitting by orthogonal least squares (CMF -OLS), an optimization method is proposed, which is suitable for sparse correlated source localization in small aperture planar array. The traditional CMF -OLS method considers the estimation of source correlation and obtains source localization by iteratively identifying the index where the maximization of the projection of the sample covariance matrix in the space spanned by the atom for the candidate source and the previously identified source. However, this method has the defect of low spatial resolution in the case of low-frequency or long-distance measurement, which is mainly due to the increase of correlation of small aperture array scanning matrix in this case. It will interfere with the estimation of source correlation. Given this, this paper proposes an optimization method based on global backtracking, which rechecks all the previously selected source locations in each iteration, corrects the error sources, and ensures the best current projection results to reduce the impact of the scanning matrix. Simulation results show that the optimization method can significantly improve the localization accuracy of multiple sound sources in the case of low-frequency or long-distance measurement under the use of small aperture plane array.

articleTitle: Design of medical robot control system based on single-chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to save manpower, improve the management of COVID-19 prevention and prevent the spread of the epidemic, this paper proposes and designs a medical robot based on a one-chip computer. The single-chip STC89C52 is used as the main control core. Obstacles are detected by infrared sensors. And the robot uses the tracking module to determine the path. The working states of the two DC motors are then changed by the IO-port control L298N drive template, thereby changing the motion state of the robot through the speed difference between the motors on both sides. In the intelligent tracking module, the robot first uses a genetic algorithm to find the best path forward inspection and then enters the ward. After disinfection, the robot uses STM32F4 to drive the OV2640 camera to collect data and detect the mask using the yolov5s algorithm. Finally, it sends the collected information to the computer to realize the real-time monitoring of the patient's condition. The simulation results show that the medical robot can effectively and accurately realize the requirements of path planning, facial mask recognition, and wireless communication. This will significantly improve the efficiency and safety of medical staff.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Anomalous Detection of Thermal Flow Value Based on Isolated Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and authenticity of the heat flow value collection data of the current building envelope, enhance the ability of on-site detection, and make each building maintain a more efficient energy saving state, it is particularly important to process the abnormal data after the heat flow value collection. Therefore, this paper proposes the feature weight-based iForest algorithm improved by the CRITIC weight method. First, we extract the data feature set and weight set, build W -iTree according to the weight, and finally integrate W-iForest to calculate the anomaly score of the data. This experiment compares the improved isolated forest algorithm with the traditional isolated forest algorithm. We show that the improved isolated forest algorithm detects anomaly data.

articleTitle: Research on Image Recognition Method Based on Improved Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the 1960s, Hubel et al. proposed the concept of receptive field through the study of cat visual cortex cells[1]. In the 1980s, Fukushima [2] proposed the concept of neurocognitive machine based on the concept of receptive field, which can be regarded as the first implementation of convolutional neural network (CNN). The neurocognitive machine will decompose a visual pattern into many sub-patterns (features), and then enter the hierarchical hierarchical connected feature plane for processing. It tries to model the visual system so that it can complete recognition even when the object has displacement or slight deformation. CNN is a variant of multi-layer perceptron (MLP), developed from biologists Huber and Wessel's [3] early research on the visual cortex of cats. There is a complex structure in the cells of the visual cortex, and these cells are very sensitive to the sub-regions of the visual input space, called the receptive field.[4] CNN was proposed by Yann Lecun of New York University in 1998 [5]. In essence, CNN is widely used neural network architecture. The success lies in the local connection and weight sharing adopted by CNN. On the other hand, the complexity of the model is reduced, that is, the risk of overfitting is reduced. In this paper, using CNN as the research method, image recognition is studied by illustrating a set of comparative experiments. In the comparative experiment, I will optimize the network model of previous experiments, and finally effectively and significantly improve the efficiency of model training.

articleTitle: Design of Power Battery Monitoring System for New Energy Bus
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a new energy bus power battery monitoring system is designed, which can realize real-time monitoring of the temperature, humidity, air pressure, smoke and other state data of the power battery cabin environment, and effectively use these data to detect and check problems in advance, save maintenance costs and prolong battery life. In the design process, the sensor is selected and configured reasonably to ensure the accuracy of the collected information.

articleTitle: Towards Interpretable and Lightweight Intrusion Detection for In-vehicle Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Along with the improvement of informatization and intelligence in modern vehicles, the attacks aimed at in-vehicle network has been becoming an emerging threat. Current methods such as neural network-based methods have shown a state-of-the-art performance on intrusion detection based on in-vehicle network monitoring. However, the limitations in interpretability and resource consumption remain the non-negligible obstales for practical applications and deployments. In this paper, we propose and build an interpretable and lightweight framework based on shapelets model for in-vehicle network intrusion detection. We conduct massive experiments on a real-world dataset, namely Car-Hacking 2019 to evaluate our detection framework. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed method can reach or surpass state-of-the-art methods in four different adversarial scaneraios with extremely low time consumption, while providing interpretable results with visual explanations for further investigations.

articleTitle: Design of Temperature Monitoring System of Fresh Product Self-collection Cabinet Based on LoRa
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For the delivery within the fresh food industry, it is difficult to coordinate the courier and customer pickup time, and the customer cannot pick up the goods in time. Especially in the summer or winter temperature extremes in the environment of fresh food more prone to spoilage. A LoRa-based wireless temperature control cabinet monitoring system is designed to solve this problem. The system incorporates various IoT technologies and consists of a terminal controller, sensors, actuation units and a host computer. This design uses STM32F407 microprocessor as the core to monitor the temperature inside the cabinet in real time and control the electric heating film and semiconductor cooler for temperature control through PID algorithm. The monitoring terminal receives the temperature through the LoRa sensor and visualizes it. It is also possible to set the temperature you want to achieve in the host computer. The test results show that the system achieves real-time monitoring of the fresh cabinet with stable data transmission and has good prospects.

articleTitle: Pre-processing Transformation for Enhancing the Transferability of Adversarial Examples
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Deep neural networks are susceptible to adversarial examples, which can cause misclassification of the models by adding some imperceptible perturbations to the original input images. Although most existing adversarial attack methods have achieved convincing success rates under white-box settings, they tend to exhibit weak transferability with the challenging black-box settings. Therefore, we propose a method based on input image pre-processing transformation named Shear & Pad Method (SPM) by optimizing the input diversity of the original images to generate adversarial examples. Meanwhile, it can alleviate the overfitting to improve the transferability of the adversarial examples. In addition, this method can be combined with related methods such as the family of fast gradient sign method to build stronger attack methods against the defense trained models. It can also be integrated into other transformation-based methods to generate more adversaries with better black-box transferability. Extensive experiments on the ImageNet dataset show that our proposed method has higher success rates than existing baseline attack methods both on a single model and an ensemble of models. Therefore, we hope that our method can be used as an effective benchmark for evaluating the robustness of deep network models.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Low- Latency Communication of Same-Node Virtual Network Functions
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the NFV scenario, a physical computing node will deploy multiple virtual network functions, and the communication latency between these network functions is an important factor of the network service of quality. This paper analyzes three ways to realize the communication of the same node network function, tests and compares the latency of the three ways through experiments. The results show that the communication method based on shared memory can bring the lowest latency. This paper also tests the impact of different packet sizes and different load pressures on the delay based on shared memory. The results show that as the load increases, the delay of different size packets shows different growth trends.

articleTitle: Research on Volleyball Players Tracking Based on Improved DeepSORT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to reduce the problems of identity switching caused by occlusion in volleyball video, we propose a method named Vol-DeepSORT based on DeepSORT for tracking volleyball players. According to the principle that the number of players is unchanged in a fixed playing area, we improved the DeepSORT algorithm that rematches the new tracks with the vanishing tracks by the minimum Euclidean Distance, so as to realize the recovery of the player identity. We use the improved algorithm Vol-DeepSORT combined with YOLOv5 to detect and track the players. Experimental results show that the MOTA of Vol-DeepSORT is 90.07%, and the frequency of identity switching is reduced by 30% compared with the original DeepSORT. The proposed algorithm can reduce the frequency of identity switching on players to a certain extent and achieve a good tracking performance.

articleTitle: GNN-Guided Track Branch Formation For Multiple Hypothesis Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Multiple Hypothesis Tracking (MHT) has shown its powerful performance in multiple target tracking applications. To reduce the number of formed track hypotheses, MHT usually defines three correlation gates called extrapolation, initiation and correlation gate, and create track hypotheses based on the observation falling in the gate. However, in closely spaced multitarget scenarios, observations of new target may fall within the initiation gate of existing track for a long time, leading to the difficulty of track initialization. Similarly, the track may also break due to the gating rules. In this paper, we propose to utilize global nearest neighbor (GNN) association result to guide track branch formation in MHT and format track branches based on the GNN association result. Simulation experiments show that the proposed GNN-guided approach is able to solve the above problems and controls the computational complexity well.

articleTitle: Design of the Main Controller of Rotary Steerable System Based on FreeRTOS
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Rotary steerable system needs to coordinate multiple functions and modules in real-time. If a nested interrupt processing method is used, it may lead to erroneous interrupt cascades and result in unpredictable execution time and high stack requirements. This paper developed the main controller based on the FreeRTOS and provided a preemptive task scheduling mechanism that can achieve the specified operation and response within a specific time. More specifically, the demand of the rotary steerable system was analyzed, and then the transplant of FreeRTOS to a DSP TMS320F28335 and task priorities assignment were introduced. Finally, the real-time performance of the main controller was tested through General Purpose Input/Output and DSP's load rates. The experiment results showed that the system achieved the required real-time performance and met the needs of the rotary steerable system.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Data Intensive Heterogeneous Task Scheduling Method Based on Parallel GATS-TS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Data-intensive applications need to process ever-increasing massive data, which puts forward high requirements on the performance of computing resources. Traditional scheduling methods can no longer adapt to the randomness of heterogeneous tasks, so a large-scale data-intensive heterogeneous task scheduling method based on parallel GATS-TS algorithm is proposed. According to the large-scale data task scheduling strategy, the tasks of the whole workflow are divided into various stages according to the data dependence, and then the task scheduling is carried out step by step. Large-scale data-intensive heterogeneous tasks are classified and the performance of each node is dynamically evaluated according to the different task types. According to the classification results of heterogeneous tasks, the completion time of tasks to be assigned at each stage was determined, and the scheduling model was established by using the parallel GATS- TS algorithm. The fitness function of the algorithm was the reciprocal of the completion time, and the model output the optimization results of intensive heterogeneous task scheduling. The test results show that the design method can shorten the task completion time and reduce the scheduling length ratio, and achieve good scheduling results under the condition of large number of tasks

articleTitle: A Practical Method for Blind Detection of Centralized Unique Word TDMA Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In non-cooperative environments, the performance of burst signal detection is generally poor due to signal parameters being completely unknown as well as a low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). In order to improve the result of TDMA burst signal detection in non-cooperative environments, firstly, this paper proposed a unique word sequence extraction method based on time delay conjugate multiplication. Secondly, using data-assisted methods, combined with cumulative spectrum calculation and energy-based pulse detection algorithms, this paper also proposed a complete set of TDMA burst signal detection systems in non-cooperative environments. The feasibility and correctness of the algorithm are verified by the actual satellite signal collected in a low SNR environment.

articleTitle: Research on PV Stock Prediction based on Time Series ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The photovoltaic (PV) building integration plate is new. To understand this plate's future development trend, the time prediction model and coefficient correlation analysis model are established to predict and analyze this plate. We used Python to preprocess the data, including comparing trading days for each stock and processing missing values. According to the data after analysis, we established the moving average model of photovoltaic building integration. In this paper, the time series auto regression integreate moving average (ARIMA) model predicts the plate index according to the previous data. The error is made between the expected results and the actual data. Finally, we improve the ESTABLISHED ARIMA model and use the improved model to predict the changing trend of the plate index two months later and draw the moving average line.

articleTitle: Color Image Encryption Algorithm Based on DNA Encoding And Memristor Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In image encryption, in order to help the image resist the known plaintext attack, selective plaintext attack and differential attack, and improve the singularity of DNA coding algorithm, the association of plaintext, ciphertext and chaotic initial value is proposed, as well as the iterative operation combining plaintext, ciphertext and chaotic sequence in DNA operation. After encryption, through the analysis of histogram, correlation coefficient, information entropy, plaintext sensitivity and other aspects, it is proved that the algorithm can well resist differential attacks and select plaintext attacks, and image encryption is more secure.

articleTitle: Interference Suppression of Broadband Signal based on Short-time Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The Adaptive Line Enhancer (ALE) algorithm, wavelet transform processing and classical feature subspace decomposition method, and short-time Fourier transform algorithm are deduced and implemented in this paper. In this paper, broadband interference in linear frequency modulation (LFM) is used as the suppression object. Due to the limitation of the LMS algorithm, the interference can not be suppressed in the normal step size adjustment range. Compared with the ALE algorithm, the short-time Fourier transform (STFT) algorithm has the best suppression effect of wideband interference. It suppressed wideband interference without destroying the information in the frequency domain. It did not have the premise that the bandwidth of wideband interference is smaller than the delay of narrowband signal. The experimental results show that the ALE and STFT algorithms perform better against wideband interference.

articleTitle: Designing an Efficient Image Encryption-Then-Compression System by Using Interweaving Permutation and Blockchain-Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we design a novel image encryption-then-compression (ETC) system by using interweaving permutation and blockchain-watermarking. Firstly, the original image is uniformly down-sampled by using interweaving permutation to produce a set of down-sampled images. Secondly, we encrypt each down-sampled image by using a same random permutation matrix individually. Since the encrypted down-sampled images preserve the correlation of the down-sampled ones, they are also highly correlated. Thridly, they are fed into the DPCM encoder to generate binary bitstream. Besides, we also use the encrypted image to generate a blockchain-watermarking to protect the integrity of the image. The experiment results show that the compression performance of the proposed method is significantly better than previous image ETC schemes. More notably, the proposed approach achieves even higher peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) values than JPEG for near-lossless image compression case.

articleTitle: Research on Selection of Special Shell Materials based on Cluster Model and Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The container shell has a good heat dissipation effect in seawater. In this paper, the selection of Marine container materials is further optimized by considering seawater's depth, density, corrosion and the materials' cost. By analyzing various characteristics of materials, we select important factors that affect material selection. Through cluster analysis, the decision-making factors are classified into three systematic evaluation indexes: service life, material cost and heat dissipation effect. This paper uses the analytic hierarchy process to analyze and establish the correlation between different factors. The influence weight of each characteristic factor of material on the decision of material selection is calculated by constructing the judgment matrix. According to the weight ratio of various factors, we find that the selection of container shell material pays more attention to the characteristics of material pressure resistance, material composition and material density. Finally, we selected a better scheme by referring to the properties and uses of several materials in relevant information: Radiator structural material can be selected Inhibited Admiralty Brass, High Silicon Bronze A, CDA 655, we can use Inconel 625, Titanium 6Al-4V, Beryllium-copper, or CDA 172 to protect the server.

articleTitle: The Target Recognition Algorithm based on the Coordinate Attention Mechanism and the Mutual-channel Loss
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To order to meet the target detection and recognition needs of the helicopter / UA V cooperative situation awareness system, the target recognition algorithm based on the coordinate attention mechanism and mutual-channel Loss of UA V is proposed. Our method uses deep separable convolution and a double threshold attention mechanism to build a lightweight deep convolution neural network with strong feature extraction ability and uses a loss function based on feature channel information to drive the network model to obtain convolution features with strong discrimination. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively obtain higher UAV target recognition accuracy, and reduce neural network parameters and computing costs. It can provide new ideas and solutions for the realization of element awareness tasks in a helicopter/UAV cooperative situation awareness system.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Power Communication Network Based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of power grid construction, traditional power maintenance methods are difficult to meet the current grid maintenance needs. Based on the needs of new smart grid communication system maintenance, this paper proposes a power communication network maintenance method based on improved convolutional neural networks. First, establish a model of power communication network failure, analyze modules with more failure probability, and propose a quantitative model to reduce the risk cost of communication failure, and improve it based on the long-short memory deep neural network, and determine the power grid communication based on the output of the model. The strategy of equipment maintenance provides a certain strategy for the construction of smart communication grid.

articleTitle: A new model for the equipment construction of complex information system
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of equipment software and hardware technology, the traditional research and development mode of information systems can no longer meet the needs of rapid change of business applications, and traditional computing facilities and software architectures have also seriously limited the expansion of combat capabilities. Therefore, the top-level system planning of the information system is insufficient, resulting in the inherent defects of the information system in cross-generation development, interconnection, research and development costs, etc., and due to the rapid development of demand and technology, the existing research and development model can no longer meet the needs of equipment use. Therefore, according to the US military information system and the Internet software research and development model, this paper proposes an open and iterative new model for the construction of complex information system equipment, solves systemic problems and on-demand problems, and forms the overall technical framework of complex information system equipment system

articleTitle: Research on Epidemic Material Management Method Based on Fabric Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The issue of openness and transparency of donated material information has always been widely concerned by caring people from all walks of life, but the issues of management transparency and material traceability have not been properly resolved. In response to the above problems, this study explores the integration of Fabric technology with the management system based on SpringBoot+SpringCloud+Mybatis+Redis+Vue.js technology through the study of Hyperledger Fabric blockchain technology, which proposes a epidemic material management method based on Fabric blockchain technology and realizes the epidemic management system based on blockchain technology. The developed system can effectively solve the problems of non-disclosure, opacity, and easy tampering of epidemic material information, and effectively improve the traceability of information in the process of epidemic material relief management from the perspective of information technology, which has good practical significance and economic value.

articleTitle: Research on Memory Attacks and Defenses for Programmable Logic Controllers
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) are the core of industrial control systems (ICS), which play an essential role in critical infrastructure. In recent years, significant real-world attacks against PLCs have emerged, causing devastating consequences to critical infrastructure. In this paper, we first introduce the architecture and memory system of PLC. We then systematically analyze the existing PLC memory attack methods and classify them into five types according to different attack vectors. Subsequently, we present three types of mainstream PLC memory attack detection methods and compare the detection ability against our proposed memory attacks. Finally, we discuss the challenges of existing PLC memory attack detection.

articleTitle: A Model-based Systems Engineering Methodology for Aircraft Air-ground Status Management
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A modern civil aircraft is a mega system that includes complicated sub-systems with intricate wire connections and signal exchanges. Air-ground status as a crucial operating parameter for various on-board systems is long discovered to have lacked consistency and incurred a series of coordination problems. In aviation industry, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) method has been extensively applied so as to manage comprehensive projects, but little research has targeted on using MBSE to improve air-ground status management. This article introduces air-ground status concept, provides air-ground signal design guidelines and proposes a novel MBSE air-ground status management method. Using SysML, the approach is capable of depicting signal propagation and system composition, setting up a universal standard for system designers to follow, rendering easy access to error tracing and problem solving and spurring reliability and stability of signal related aircraft architecture design.

articleTitle: An Improved CRC-Aided BP-BMA Concatenation Decoding for Polar Code
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Belief propagation (BP) is an iterative and parallel decoding algorithm for polar code that satisfies high throughput and low latency requirements in 5G scenarios. In this work, we proposed a cyclic redundancy check aided belief propagation decoding with the box and match algorithm (CBP-BMA) to enhance the error-correction performance further. This algorithm first runs the BP decoder with early stopping criteria and then uses the soft decoded BP log-likelihood ratio (LLR) as the soft input to the box and match algorithm (BMA) decoder. The simulation results show that even if the reprocessing order of the BMA decoder is as low as one, the proposed algorithm shows a significant improvement than BP decoding. With code rate R=0.5 and code length N=128, the suggested algorithm has a gain of roughly 0.3dB at the desired bit error rate (BER) of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">–3</sup>.

articleTitle: Integration and Verification of Measurement System Covered Position and Dynamic Information
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the development of computer, processor and communication technology, it is necessary to master the position and dynamic information of a moving object, and to explore the relationship between its position, state and response characteristic. And the position information of an outdoor and indoor moving object can be measured by GNSS and total station instrument respectively. For example, the position information can be gained from GNSS or total station with high precision, and the ship motion and state signals can be measured by professional sensors during the ship sailing and model testing. Because the sampling frequency of dynamic signals is much higher than the output frequency of GNSS and total station instrument, the precise synchronization of the two kinds of data becomes an urgent problem. In this paper, precise time stamps are added to the signals of measuring equipment and acquisition module by using GPS or software time clock service, and time stamp records of dynamic test data can be obtained, so precise synchronization of two kinds of signals can be implemented. Based on the position and dynamic information measuring instrument, data acquisition and transmission module, an integrated testing system of position and dynamic information is constructed. In order to verify the reliability and validity of the integrated measuring system, a hovercraft model test is designed and carried out, and the measuring results is consistent with the hovercraft traits.

articleTitle: Arrhythmia Classifier using Binarized Convolutional Neural Network for Resource-Constrained Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Monitoring electrocardiogram signals are of great significance for the diagnosis of arrhythmias. In recent years, deep learning and convolutional neural networks have been widely used in the classification of cardiac arrhythmias. However, the existing neural network applied to ECG signal detection usually requires a lot of computing resources, which is not friendly to resource-constrained equipment, and it is difficult to realize real-time monitoring. In this paper, a binarized convolutional neural network suitable for ECG monitoring is proposed, which is hardware-friendly and more suitable for use in resource-constrained wearable devices. Targeting the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database, the classifier based on this network reached an accuracy of 95.67% in the five-class test. Compared with the proposed baseline full-precision network with an accuracy of 96.45%, it is only 0.78% lower. Importantly, it achieves 12.65 times the computing speedup, 24.8 times the storage compression ratio, and only requires a quarter of the memory overhead.

articleTitle: A Novel Physical Layer Key Generation Method Based on WGAN-GP Adversarial Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The reciprocity of wireless channel between legitimate nodes is the premise of physical layer security key generation. Deep neural networks provide the non-linear transformation method to extract symmetric keys from reciprocal channel responses and show better freedom and performance than traditional methods. However, the hidden layer output in neural networks is unpredictable and the extracted high-dimensional features can not be estimated in advance, which is difficult to be applied to the key generation in the physical layer. In this paper, the key generation method based on WGAN-GP adversarial autoencoder is proposed to extract features efficiently between legitimate nodes, and the features can be fitted to the Gaussian distribution. Meanwhile, the Wasserstein distance and gradient penalty are applied in the game training to solve the gradient explosion. Compared with the PCA method, the proposed method has higher security key capacity, lower key error rate, and no interaction in the key generation process, which avoids key leakage.

articleTitle: Improvement and optimization of consensus algorithm based on PBFT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved consensus algorithm based on PBFT(EBCR-PBFT). Firstly, The Modified Random Select(MRS) function is used to perform preliminary screening of network nodes, so as to solve the problem of multiple and redundant network nodes. Secondly, based on the idea of clustering, logical stratification of blockchain network nodes can reduce communication times and improve network efficiency. Thirdly, the core module of MRS is optimized by FPGA to further improve the efficiency of the algorithm. At the same time, the improved dynamic reputation evaluation model is introduced to evaluate and feedback the node behavior in time to ensure the smooth operation of the system. Experiments show that the proposed and optimized consensus algorithm can effectively improve the consensus efficiency, timely punish malicious nodes, increase the reliability of nodes, communication overhead, throughput, delay and other high performance, has a certain application value.

articleTitle: Research on non-invasive load monitoring based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Non-invasive load monitoring technology is widely used in building energy conservation, wisdom city, smart grid and other fields In this paper, the convolution neural network is used to analyze the non-invasive load monitoring technology. Firstly, the research results of convolution neural network algorithm used by domestic and foreign scholars in the field of non-intrusive load monitoring are summarized and analyzed. Because the V-I trajectory curves of some electrical appliances are similar and difficult to distinguish, the features are optimized in this paper, and the V-I trajectory features and the current harmonic features are binarized and combined to form a combination matrix, and the combined matrix is used as the input of the convolutional neural network. Secondly, the application principle of the convolutional neural network and the process of model training are studied, and the reliability of the combined features of this paper is verified by simulation, and the accurate identification of electrical appliances is realized. Finally, the future research direction is prospected.

articleTitle: 3D Dual-stream Convolutional Neural Networks with Simple Recurrent Unit Network: A New Framework for Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Human action recognition is a supervised process of labeling an entire video image sequence with action labels in computer vision fields. Different from the recognition of static images, this process also needs to learn the contact information between video frames, such as the timing characteristics that reflect the changes of actions in the video. In existing deep learning methods, due to the size of the convolution kernel, the models use a small number of consecutive frames as input and trains to assign feature vectors to short sequences instead of the entire sequence. Therefore, even if the learned features contain time information, their evolution over time will be completely ignored. In this work, we propose a dual-stream deep fusion framework that can fully utilize the long-term information of a video. We preprocess the video into static frames and optical flow graphs and input them into a three-dimensional convolutional neural network to obtain the spatiotemporal feature stream with time series. Then, the spatiotemporal feature stream is input into a simple recurrent unit network to learn the long-term sequence features of the time dimension. Finally, SoftMax classifier is used for feature classification. We tested our model on the classic action recognition UCF -101 and HMDB-S1 data sets, and our model achieved better performance than existing methods.

articleTitle: Shifting Classification of Automatic Transmission Based on Shapelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: During the driving process of the vehicle, a large amount of time series containing shifting information was continuously generated. It is a laborious process to accurately detect the factory quality inspection and shifting characteristics of automatic transmissions through these data. In this context, this paper proposed a method to classify shifting data using shapelet transform, which is a local shape similarity classification method based on the most discriminative subsequence in a time series. In consideration of the low efficiency of traditional shapelet extraction methods, we introduce the idea of mathematical statistical probabilistic models into the extraction of shapelets. More specifically, we first build a probabilistic model of the training dataset and sample some time series from the training dataset by the utilization of distribution estimation algorithm (EDA). Then we use the probabilistic model update method to find discriminative subsequences in the time series as shapelet candidates. We next prune highly similar shapelet candidates through shapelet filters. Finally, we use the best k shapelets to convert each time series in the dataset into k corresponding features, which can be used in conjunction with traditional classifiers to classify the data. The automatic transmission shifting classification experiment shows that the shapelet discovery algorithm based on the probability model proposed in this paper can greatly improve the efficiency of the algorithm while ensuring the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of Ant Colony Algorithm in the Field of Urban Intelligent Transportation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Transportation strongly promotes the development of the national economy and plays a vital role in modern society. But at the same time, the development of transportation has also brought great problems. Traffic accidents have caused a large number of deaths and economic losses, and road traffic has caused uncoordinated surrounding environment, deteriorating environment, and rapid energy consumption. Intelligent transportation system (ITS) can provide an effective way to solve the above problems, effectively coordinate traffic management, and provide users with more comfortable and effective travel or transportation modes. Besides, it can also make full use of energy by means of increasing the flow of the road network, reduce the exhaust emission of vehicles, and solve the increasingly serious environmental problems. It can also create a better environment for transporting goods and promote the development of the national economy. Therefore, this paper has completed the following tasks: 1) Briefly introduced the background of this paper and the significance of the optimal path planning algorithm research, expounded the existing path planning status, and affirmed the significance of the path planning algorithm. 2) The ant colony algorithm (ACA) is described in detail, including the basic model, algorithm steps, and algorithm characteristics of the ACA, and the parameters of the ACA are discussed. Then the improved ACA and hierarchical ACA are proposed in this paper. 3) The data map used in the experiment is designed, and then the simulation software is used to carry out the experiment. The results show that the improved ACA proposed in this paper has superior performance.

articleTitle: Grid Division-Based Service Migration Path Selection Method in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Edge computing provides computing resources on the side close to the data source, which can reduce latency and bandwidth consumption. The growing distance between users and edge servers may lead to degradation of service quality or even service interruption. Attribute to the variation in network structures, different migration paths can generate different latency, and our work focuses on the selection of migration paths. In this paper, a grid-based path selection algorithm is proposed to perform heuristic path selection, which is based on the edge server load, transmission bandwidth, and physical location, and finally, obtain an optimal service migration path. Through real-data simulation experiments, we found that the algorithm proposed in this paper performs better in terms of running time, transmission time, and service following compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent Retail Settlement Platform based on Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Automated Checkout (ACO) systems have high requirements for accuracy and speed in real retail scenarios. The research of ACO based on image recognition technology faces great challenges due to the lack of high-quality datasets, high merchandise granularity, and high model training costs. This project adopts PP-ShiTu algorithm based on mainbody detection, metric learning, and vector retrieval, and incorporates knowledge distillation and data enhancement strategies so as to carry out the implementation of merchandise recognition capability and effectively improve the prediction speed and recognition accuracy. With the feature learning dataset of retail scenes, the method adopted in this project can effectively balance the retrieval accuracy and speed, and improve the security and stability of the recognition process. Meanwhile, this project combines AIoT to connect “cloud, edge and end”, forming an integrated and intelligent retail settlement platform.

articleTitle: Multi-target position electromagnetic power synthesis based on time-reversal technology
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The temporal and spatial focusing property is the most important characteristic of time-reversal electromagnetic waves. Based on this characteristic, the adaptive power synthesis of multi-target positions is studied herein. First, a spatial power synthesis model of stationary distributed arrays under single target and single-frequency signal conditions is established. This model is then extended to multi-target situations. On this basis, the effects of positioning errors, time synchronization errors, and beacon signal patterns on the power synthesis efficiency are analyzed. The results indicate that by using the inherent characteristics of time-reversed electromagnetic waves, only the time-reversal processing and transmission of the signals received by all distributed array nodes within the same time window need to be synchronized, so that adaptive coherent synthesis of the backtracking signals can be realized at the target radiation source position, thereby achieving the purpose of energy-efficient focusing. In contrast to the traditional active phase control technology, the time-reversal technology omits the steps of signal sorting and identification, phase compensation, and waveform design. In addition, the synthesis efficiency at each target radiation source position under the same conditions is significantly improved.

articleTitle: An Initialization Method for Monocular Visual-Inertial Odometry Based on Uncertainty State
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In recent years, monocular visual-inertial systems (VINS) has been widely used and studied in U A V, three-dimensional reconstruction, augmented reality and other fields. Due to the nonlinearity of the whole system, its initialization stage is very critical and vulnerable. The traditional initialization mode is either relatively fixed or has certain requirements for the motion mode. Therefore, in order to overcome this problem and improve the robustness and accuracy of system initialization, we integrate and improve an adaptive monocular visual-inertial SLAM initialization method based on the VINS-Mono[7] framework. Firstly, the initial motion state is judged by the state mode selection algorithm, then two initialization modules are divided to refine the initial mode, realize accurate estimation, and improve the robustness and accuracy of visual inertial joint online initialization. Finally, experiments are carried out on public datasets, and the results show that the proposed method has a greater improvement in convergence and robustness than VINS-Mono.

articleTitle: A Fine Three-dimensional Adaptive Color Segmentation Algorithm for Real-time Vision System of Soccer Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The aim of the vision system for small soccer robots is to recognize and track robots and soccer ball in a semi-open environment. Traditional color segmentation methods are usually sensitive to external conditions, for example light changes or uneven distribution. Machine learning-based methods usually require advanced hardware as well as huge amount of data. To overcome these limitations, we propose a fine three-dimensional adaptive color classification method in this paper. The presented method determines the thresholds in color space dynamically. For distinguishing the overlapping area in color space, Naive Bayes classifier is used to classify the color categories which obey the Multivariate Normal Distribution. Dynamic adaptive lighting is introduced to enhance the performance, and the robustness of classification is increased by combining multiple brightness separable color space. This method is embedded in a vision system for Soccer Robot to enhance the processing performance. The experiments show that the system is robust and achieves high precision. It can process the soccer video in real-time with detection rate of 99.68 % and precision of 99.92 %.

articleTitle: Lomber Lens Technology and its Application in Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Lomber lens technology is a technology that subverts the existing wireless coverage architecture and has a wide range of applications. It must be widely used in 5G and future high-frequency wireless communication systems. Under the requirements of multi scene, accurate target positioning and large terminal capacity, the performance characteristics of high gain, multi beam and multi frequency multi beam of Lomber lens antenna will play a greater role and become a new technical path. In this paper, the application advantages of various types of Lombard lens in different scenes are analyzed in detail. With the development of material technology, Lombard lens antenna is bound to get the attention of the market with its excellent performance.

articleTitle: Review of research on load forecasting methods for smart grid
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the addition of a large number of loads in the distribution network and the optimal scheduling of power systems,the problem of dynamic balance between the supply side and the demand side has been paid more and more attention. As an important way to solve the problem, accurate load forecasting can not only ensure the safe and reliable operation of the system, but also improve the utilization rate of power generation and avoid the waste of power resources. This paper first discusses the types of power load forecasting and the load forecasting framework.The forecasting framework is developed according to four modules, namely data collection, feature extraction, characteristic analysis and final load forecasting application; Then, according to the analysis of electricity load characteristics, the residential load characteristic index system is established in three dimensions of day, month and year, and discusses the mainstream feature extraction methods; Finally, the characteristics of various load forecasting methods are summarized and analyzed.

articleTitle: Intelligent Deployment Strategy based on genetic algorithm for components in software radar information processing platforms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: We studied the deployment strategy of software components in a software radar information processing platform, and proposed a strategy to help achieve intelligent deployment of components through an improved genetic algorithm. The software components are efficiently and reasonably deployed on each server in a distributed manner to achieve load balancing and efficient deployment while avoiding server overload or resource waste. Simulation results show that compared with the traditional genetic algorithm, the intelligent deployment strategy proposed in this paper has more obvious advantages in terms of execution time and resource utilization, and can better achieve system resource allocation.

articleTitle: Radiance Transfer of diffuse objects in dynamic scenes
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Many rendering algorithms related to Precomputed Radiance Transfer (PRT) have been proposed to render moving objects with more or less precomputation. We present a novel real-time technique for rendering diffuse objects which eliminates scene-dependent precomputation. In our approach, the visibility term is sampled during runtime with the help of real-time ray tracing technique. We introduce spatial and temporal filtering for denoising shading results due to low sample frequency. According to our results, the computational cost is low enough to be applied to video games running on the new generation of graphics cards designed for real-time ray tracing.

articleTitle: Intelligent safe driving solution based on multi-source information fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: At present, the existing safe driving monitoring system technologies, such as passive technology (based on vehicle information) and active technology (based on biosensors and visual sensors), cannot directly detect drivers, and are prone to false positives and high costs.
