Therefore, based on deep learning, hardware acceleration, and multi-sensor technology, this paper studies the intelligent safe driving solution of multi-source information fusion, improves and integrates the existing Retinaface and Retinanet solutions, proposes a line of sight direction classification algorithm based on feature points and a fatigue index algorithm based on multi-scale features, and develops a set of Alcohol, GPS and other multi-sensor fusion vehicle monitoring FPGA module is equipped with a hardware accelerator based on convolutional neural network. A visual application program based on MVVM and a wearable device module based on the multi-sensor fusion of temperature, blood oxygen, and heart rate are developed. This scheme can realize the integration of passive technology and active technology and has the function of a collaborative analysis of vehicle data, driver health data, and attitude information. It can cover a variety of scenes at the same time, with high transmission security and greatly improved accuracy.

articleTitle: Application Research on Total-Elements Simulation and Deduction platform for Phased Array Radar System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Phased array radar is a massive electronic system, and the process of its demonstration and design is complex and expensive. As related software and hardware technology advances, the digital software radar system simulation platform is becoming an increasingly important technical means for modern radar research and development. At present, most of the research on radar simulation focus on the radar itself or subsystems of the radar. However, in fact radar is an equipment of environment perception, and its performance is closely related to the battlefield environment, which is a key factor that cannot be ignored in radar system simulation. In this article, a simulation method including physical environment and radar system is proposed, realizing the interactive closed-loop simulation of environment and radar, which can be called ‘Total- Elements simulation’. Then a total-elements simulation platform for a phased array radar system is established and the system architecture, development environment selection and subsystem design of the total-elements simulation platform are discussed. The simulation results of a radar prototype verify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed total-elements modeling and simulation platform. This study would offer significant help for rapid evaluation of the tactical performance before production, and optimization of the demonstration and design. It shows a practical and meaningful instruction to lower technical risks and reduce R&D cost during the development course, and also has some application value for the research of software radar.

articleTitle: An Automatic Feature Selection Model for Running Sprint Reorganization Using Wrist Accelerometers
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For the existing motion recognition tasks, few researchers have studied running sprint, that is, the sprint part of the running segment is discriminated. In order to monitor the running situation of sportsman, we proposed an Automatic Feature Selection Mode (AFSM) for running sprint reorganization using wrist accelerometers. First, information such as acceleration signal is collected through wearable devices. After pre-processing and feature extraction, an automatic feature selection algorithm is used to select important features. We also propose two key features, heart rate and acceleration derivatives, for experiment. The experimental results show that AFSM can automatically screen useful features to achieve better classification accuracy, effectively identify the sprint period in the running segment, and the recognition accuracy rate reaches 83.7%; Heart rate and acceleration derivatives are the key information for sprint recognition, which can significantly improve the classification effect, improve the accuracy rate by 1.77<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and achieve more accurate recognition.

articleTitle: Multi-trajectory prediction of 5G network for smart grid based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: 5G mobile communication technology has the advantages of ultra-large connections, ultra-low latency, ultra-high bandwidth etc. Smart grid is a typical 5G vertical application field, which includes various types of 5G mobile terminals, such as power inspection robots, mobile charging piles, drones, and electric work vehicles. The mobility of such terminals inevitably causes load fluctuation of 5G network. Predicting the trajectories of these mobile terminals can provide effective support for customizing or optimizing the management of mobility, registration and handover. Most existing methods for trajectory prediction consider the input trajectories as independent, but in smart grids, the trajectories of mobile terminals have great correlation. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a multi-trajectory prediction method for 5G mobile terminals of smart grid based on deep learning Transformer. It adopts a double-layer structure. The first layer Transformer encodes the historical and current predicted trajectory for each mobile terminal, and the second layer Transformer further captures the correlated movement patterns among the terminals to improve the prediction performance. We simulate the collaboration work mode and division work mode of 5G terminals of smart grid, and experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.
